I would highly recommend the Canyon Suites to any and all.  Thanks for a great stay!

reviews.text: I couldn’t wait to be wowed by the luxury but I guess I will keep waiting. The grounds are stunning. The entrance is impressive. It goes downhill from there. The lobby has a smell being pumped into it that reminds me of the smell of bowling shoe spray. The rooms are nice but they are a nice Marriott room. I would not go so far as to call it luxury. Luxury doesn’t have chips in the furniture and paint. The lamps aren’t crooked. The bathroom doors close completely. Maybe the golf and tennis make up for it but the room and food DO NOT. $115 for stale chips, super vinegary wings, extremely watery blue cheese. Or how about $50 for a piece of toast. And it irritates me that my mini bar is stocked with Pepsi. Not a Coke anywhere! The staff are extremely nice and prompt so I do give them points for that. Courtney was the BEST server!

A couple hikes that are easy and close to resort we're very fun with the kids  We were here during a few larger events in the events center and still had plenty of space to be comfortable.

reviews.text: We have been coming to Holiday tea at the Phoenician for over 20 years and this is the first time I was truly disappointed in the food. They replaced their egg salad sandwich with a pickled deviled egg that tasted like a shot of apple cider vinegar. They also replaced the roast beef sandwich with a "lobster roll" which tasted like a cheap California roll from a grocery store. Sadly, even the usually delicious chicken salad sandwich was extra salty this time. The least expensive tea service for Holiday tea is $100 plus tea service fee and tax. I expect the same delicious food we have enjoyed for the occasion not what we were served. Bring back the old menu. Everyone in our party was severely disappointed and if this menu remains we will be looking for another team service not only for Holiday tea but for our other afternoon teas throughout the year. Also, do NOT change the tea pots. Stop messing with a good thing and cheapening an expensive experience. I will say the service is impeccable and we love the team at the tea room. Just fix the food!
reviews.author: Dina

reviews.text: The southwest needs to do away with these resorts. Water is a necessity and places like these unnecessarily wasteful.

reviews.text:
My husband and I went here for Thanksgiving dinner and we're grateful to have an incredible seat with an unbelievable view!
We did not order the Thanksgiving dinner meal, we ordered the filet mignon Oscar, and the porterhouse steak. They were both excellent and they were served a la carte.
We both ordered specialty cocktails off of the drink menu and I do not recommend either of them LOL.
There is an incredible patio outside unfortunately it was not open. This is worthwhile to go and get anything here just to go out on the patio and experience The View. Our service took a very very long time. We were ignored for at least 5 minutes before we even made eye contact with any server.
As I said, check it out for the view you might want to eat ahead of time unless you want to pay about $350.

reviews.text: A loud, dated, marginally maintained property.  I get here and the check in and valet is like a casino.  They misplace the car for awhile and then have to find it again because I had to drive to my room instead.  The property is clearly dated, smells like the 1980s, and has VERY SMALL and uninteresting rooms for $1000 per nights.  The rooms, in fact, are not one single amenity better than the $140/night Hilton airport hotel.  For a huge resort like this, unbelievably, the outsource their laundry meaning it takes days to return to you.   They host some kind of rock concerts on their property because loud music was thumping on my window until late in the evening.  The open spaces felt like an apartment complex with screaming kids and sports, OK, cool, but the environment is anything but relaxing.   My "casita" has an outdoor space which is shared by others neighboring me and not cleaned up a bit from the last guests who left cigarette butts drowned in a cup of beer or something on the ground in plain sight.

reviews.text: I have been coming to the Phoenician for several years. I have never had an experience like I did tonight. I pulled up to the hotel and there was a man there to valet the cars. The Phoenician always has someone to valet your car. The man that was valeting for the evening  just stood outside the booth and looked at me. I waited patiently because I assumed that he was waiting for another valet person to come. After five minutes passed, he walked toward the passenger side, I was preparing to roll down the window and before getting to the car, he turned around and went in the back of the valet station. He stayed in the back of the valet station until another car pulled up. He immediately came out and proceeded to help the lady get out of her vehicle. I got out of my car once I realized that I was actually overlooked, disregarded and not acknowledged. I asked him why he didn’t come to my car and he lied and said I wouldn’t open the car for him. I spoke to the manager and he told me that he will take my keys to the same man that refused to take my keys initially. He apologized and appeared  to be unsure how to handle the situation. He asked me if I wanted a drink. I told him that what I want is for the tape to be viewed and for him to reprimand the valet guy. I don’t want this to happen to anyone else. I am a women of color and I am hoping that this was not done for that reason.

reviews.text:
The facility and rooms were in amazing condition. It felt brand new. The resort is beautiful and I would recommend it for a couple. Unfortunately we went with children. We were under the impression it would be good for small kids because of the splash pad and kids center. This was not the case. The resort is large and if you are not in the building close to the lobby, the pool is a long walk away. For a couple this wouldn't be a problem but when you have a stroller and pool stuff, it is a pain.  The pool is large but has zero shade. Once you are in the pool, you are cooking. No canopy or structures to provide shade over any sections of the pool. Once again, fine for adults but not children.

The staff was disappointing as well. It didn't feel like a luxury service at all. Any questions seemed to have vague answers and no one was really that helpful.  We booked a crib and confirmed during check in but it was never brought to our room until I requested a third time the next day. Another thing, I know this next one sounds very petty but how do you not have iced coffee at the pool restaurant? We were brought hot coffee over ice which just melted. Just a pet peeve lol.
We did have a valet who gave my son and I a golf cart ride around the property. My son loves golf carts and this was the best service we had the whole trip.

Another thing that was not mentioned was that the parking garage cost over 20 bucks a day. How is this not included or mentioned at check in? I would have just valeted for 2 bucks more a day. Also the TV didn't have many channels (once again we had kids with us). I was excited to see a kids package but realized they charged for it. It's just tacky when a place has everything being an extra charge.

The food was mediocre and waaaay over priced. This is normal for a resort but the food just all felt dated and wasn't that good.

Overall this would be fun for a couple or a golf trip. Just not for kids.

We have stayed at the Gainey Ranch resort and that was much much better for kids.

reviews.text: We had a nice, relaxing stay in this luxurious hotel, with some misses. The cactus garden was lovely, and the pools were nice. The room was comfortable and clean. The dining experiences were hit or miss. Lunch at the Tavern was just ok. Breakfast at Mowry and Cotton was very good, and our server Gustavo was friendly; we had nachos and drinks at the Kabobery and enjoyed some of the best guacamole we've ever had plus wonderful service. Mowry's prices were high, so our 2nd day, we got bagels, breakfast sandwiches, and coffee at the Marketplace. The staff was not as warm as that at Mowry or the Kabobery, but the food and coffee were good. The only really disappointing experience was at J&G Steakhouse. I called a few weeks before our arrival to reserve a table for a Sunday evening. I told Brianne, the woman with whom I spoke, that we were flexible on time but would like to sit outdoors (partly because of Covid and partly because the view seemed pretty). She suggested that 6:30 would be a great time to eat on the deck to for a wonderful sunset view, so I made the reservation for then. When we arrived at J&G, a few minutes early, the hostess said there were no tables outside, and an older guy who worked there said nor would there be for a long time. They were pretty snide and condescending about it. No apologies. I asked the guy if we could come back in 30-45 min and be seated outside. He chuckled derisively and said it'd be more like 90 min as all the tables were just on their appetizers. We debated leaving but didn't know where else we could go on such short notice. Our servers Rianna & Gabe were nice, but the (very $$$) steaks were overdone. We asked for medium rare and got medium, disappointing for a steakhouse. Don't have your heart set on sitting outside; please note: I wasn't told we'd be seated outdoors IF a table was available or that my request had been noted; I believed, based on my conversation, that we'd be seated there. Btw, 2 tables outside opened up within 20 minutes of when we were seated. Also we hoped to go on a guided tour of the cactus gardens; a sign read that they were given MWF at 9. We went to the concierge desk Mon before 9, and no one knew anything about a tour. Later I received a call from a staff member saying that tours were given every day at 9, except for Fri at 8. There was no one there to give a tour either Mon or Tues. The garden trails are lovely though, so just take yourself on a tour! Overall, a nice stay with some minuses.

reviews.text:
UPDATE: You can see below that the Public Relations Director, from  the hotel, assured me that my concerns would be addressed.

Well, its been over a month and I still haven't heard anything. Leaving me no choice but to conclude that she was just blowing smoke with her well practiced  corporate response.

Is this non-response what is done to other people after givng assurances? Are you figuring that they'll blow off steam and then go away?

As I've now been ignored by the assigned rep, GM and Public Relatons Director,  this is clearly a systemic problem.

ORIGINAL REVIEW:
I tried to book through the group site as directed, without any luck. I called the rep assigned and it took multiple calls and emails to him, as well as a message for the GM, to get a response. One interesting point to note is that the GM never contacted me.                                                                            Additional, 2 miscellaneous charges, that I was not told about, for portage and room cleaning, were added to my final bill. I never used portage services. When I contacted the rep to dispute them, he indicated that they were disclosed on the booking site. Well, as mentioned, I booked with him directly, so I didn't get a chance to see them on the site. This was brought to his attention by email and it's been a month or so and he is now ignoring this fact.
I'm curious to see how quickly and deftly the customer relation person, who seems to respond to reviews,  responds to this one and spins it while showing false empathy and understanding with my dissatisfaction.

reviews.text: Hotel is pretty, waitstaff is nice, grounds and facilities are top notch and food is excellent.  However, the hotel did not seem to have a grasp of customer service. First, our room was not ready for 4PM check-in. After waiting 1.25 hrs. it was ready and we rec'd a $100 credit.  Mini-bar was completely empty upon arrival. Asked Concierge to arrange tennis during my stay and they handed me a sticky note with the tennis center's extension and told me to call myself and arrange it. Valet ($38/nite) had no charger available for at the main building for our Tesla. We were told we could drive across the resort ourselves to find one in another location. No chairs available in pool area except for the 30 that were available in the "Reserved Area" where they charge $50 per chair and a $50 drink min.  Made call to tennis pro shop. No one picked up and it went to voicemail. I left messages and no one returned my call. No water available in lobby, nor coffee in the morning. At $1000 per night I expected more. We didn't even get a chocolate on our pillow or water on our nightstand. Honestly, I've gotten better treatment at far less expensive hotels.  When I want to splurge again, I will spend my money elsewhere.

reviews.text: My wife, Lora, and I have stayed at many a fine hotel, and as Titanium members with Marriott, have grown accustomed to excellent customer service, but nothing has been as exceptional as our latest stay at the Phoenician in Arizona. From the moment we entered the resort, where we were warmly greeted by Eddie and Ryan at the front desk, who gave us a complimentary room upgrade, to the day we departed, when Charlotte in Food & Beverage gave us a complimentary fruit platter, the experience has been nothing short of exceptional. During our stay, when our flight was cancelled, Haley, a Front Desk Manager, and Jonathan, a Front Desk Agent, were kind and considerate, helping us negotiate another night, complete with a late checkout, for which we are grateful. Of course, the grounds of the resort are lovely, and the pools are amazing, but the best part of our wonderful stay has clearly been the people we had the pleasure of engaging with, so thank you to everyone at the Phoenician, you made Lora's and my 10 year anniversary exceptional, and we look forward to staying at your beautiful property again soon.

reviews.text:
Probably my favorite hotel! I've stayed here several times in the winter and summer. Was recently here in June 2020. Pretty busy for summer but I think everyone wanted to get out and travel with COVID pretty much gone. The hotels location is amazing.

Amazing views from the rooms and of course the pools! The pools here are so nice, even if it is 115 out. Most importantly, I LOVE that they are open 24/7. Going for a swim at midnight when no one is around and the sun is not glaring down is perfect. Not many hotels I've been to have this unfortunately. The slide is really fun. Yes, I was the only adult on it that day haha.

My only negative with my last stay was the house keeping. We stayed for almost a week and they never replaced towels or toiletries like shampoo. We had to call room service who was very quick at bringing it but shouldn't have to do that.

Other than that, it's an amazing resort. The cactus garden is amazing to see with Camelback Mountain right behind. Looking forward to come back soon.

reviews.text:
We were disappointed in a few things with our stay, however, overall it was nice:
- my husband scheduled a surprise for our 20th anniversary to have strawberries, flowers, and mimosas delivered to our room upon arrival. This was not completed and he had to call them and remind them about it once we got to the room. Definitely ruined the surprise. 
-upon check in, they did not ask us about parking or add it to our room. We had to pay to get out of the parking garage a couple of days. We went back to the desk and got it added, but ultimately, it resulted in us having to pay $23 extra since they added parking on the day we had already had to self pay to get out of the garage
-I communicated via email nearly a month in advance  to request any special ideas or upgrades that might be available given our special anniversary. While this is certainly not expected, I was simply hoping the resort might offer something. I asked if they might consider a nicer room or assist me with getting a reservation for the tea luncheon. They simply had Someone called me to tell me that there was no availability for tea for a couple months. I had already tried reserving and was aware of this, but hoped for any other options…even to be on a list in case of cancellation, but nothing was offered. Upon arrival, we were offered a room upgrade to a Mountain View, but it would be another $75/night. I chose not to upgrade given the expense of the resort already. 
Overall, beautiful resort and nicely kept!

reviews.text:
My wife, 6-month-old son and I stayed here over the past weekend. There are two of the residence units that are on top of each other, 7703 and 7704 with 7703 being on the ground level. We were unfortunately in 7703 for a 3-night stay and while the place is fantastic, you can hear EVERYTHING that's going on upstairs in 7704. We were just astonished at the level of noise that normal activity could make. Footsteps, talking, doors closing and opening, toilets flushing all sounded like this was happening in our own unit. This is something that I might expect from a cheap motel, but certainly not at a place like this especially given the amount of money we paid to stay there.

After the first night, we asked to be moved but they said the people upstairs were checking out and it wasn't booked for the next two nights but someone definitely checked in that afternoon. So, the normal activity upstairs continued to wake up our son during naps and at night meaning we had a very cranky 6-month-old the whole time we were there.

Other than that, everything was great. But if you check-in and they tell you that you are in 7703 of the Residences, buckle up, or ask to be in a different unit.

I and seven of my other mom friends left our 21 children at home with our significant others to have a girl’s weekend. We stayed at The Phoenician.  We took advantage of the pool, spa, restaurant, bar, bicycle rentals and beautiful grounds. 

Our first day we checked bikes out from the fitness center and rode to downtown Scottsdale. It was a beautiful ride! That night we had drinks at the Thirsty Camel and dinner at Mawry and Cotton. Tip-get the brussel sprouts!

The next day after hiking Echo Canyon trail we spent the rest of the day in the spa. You could literally spend all day taking advantage of the services. All of us left extremely pleased with our experience and sad that it was over!

The Phoenician was conveniently located within walking distance or a short Uber ride from everything and anything we wanted to do. All staff were very helpful when we approached them with questions and always welcoming when we passed them in hallways. All of us agreed, we would definitely stay there again.

reviews.text:
We are local residents to the Arcadia neighborhood. We typically love the Phoenician, especially during the holiday season. We are regulars of the Tavern during football season and stay often, especially during New Years Eve. 

My husband, Erik G, married his 1st wife there, which he will gladly still share with other visiting guests during every stay. 

Sadly, the last two consecutive years we have stayed there, we have received terrible views from our rooms. 

Last year, NYE 2020, we had a view of noisy AC units from our roof top. With this poor experience and our own anniversary in mind, I wanted to make sure everything was ideal. I called and made note of our celebration, as well as our need for a beautiful view. In addition, Gloria in room service, beautifully decorated the room with rose petals, wine and chocolate covered strawberries for the occasion. (Thank you, Gloria!) I again emphasized the importance of the room location and view and asked for it to be placed in the notes prior to our check in. 

With an even deeper frustration and disappointment our view was horrible. We had views of a dumpster, multiple cardboard box pallets, what appeared to be a maintenance area and a large tree blocking any direct view of the beautiful courtyards or scenery. 

My husband did attempt to contact the front desk, asking for accommodations for another complimentary night in another room and/or a discount for a 2nd night in the same poorly positioned room. Sadly, no efforts were made to resolve the room issue, only to remove the room service bill that was billed for $224 for decorating the room with roses, wine, etc., 

Obviously, a discounted room or room with a better view would have benefited everyone, as the net result would have acquired additional dining, bar and room service expenses and rebuilt our confidence in the Phoenician (now Marriott) to future stays. 

I hope this email or survey does get to  Mark (GM) directly, as I coincidentally looked him contact information up on LinkedIn just yesterday with the intentions of following up with an email addressing my concerns. 

Feel free to publicly post and/share this survey, as I intend to do the same.

Reluctantly yours, 

Christina B.
reviews.author: ChristinaB

reviews.text: The Phoenician used to be our favorite spot to visit over the Xmas holidays.  This trip could not have been more different.  Our suite was dirty with makeup stained towels that clearly had not been changed since the last guest.  The hostesses at Mowry and Cotton were incredibly rude and wouldn’t even let our party (including 90 year olds) just sit in an empty part of the restaurant while we waited 30 minutes for our table.  The staff were overwhelmed.  The managers were kind and attentive but the problems were so numerous and basic that I gave up.  This property is no longer worth the money as the experience was so bad.

reviews.text: We were to stay at this hotel for a NYE wedding. Three days prior to our arrival, our flight to PHX had been changed a few times and we could not be guaranteed an arrival. This was due to the airline's lack of crews due to COVID. We decided to cancel our trip as we had to connect coming and going. My wife, who made the reservation and is a LIFETIME Marriott TITANIUM member, had called the hotel after her credit card was charged with a one-day room charge. The hotel said that their cancellation policy was a 7-day notice, not the normal cancellation policy Marriott has and was not going to waive the charge no matter what the circumstances were. She called the Marriott help desk and they referred her back to the hotel for a "review". Today we received the notice that the hotel was not going to credit her the room charge. But they were nice enough to wish us a "Pleasant New Years and hope to see us soon". We HIGHLY recommend that you exercise caution when reserving a room at this resort DUE TO ITS UNFORGIVING RESERVATION AND CANCELLATION POLICY!

reviews.text:
I'm a TripAdvisor so I stay frequently at hotels around the country.  We were supposed to come to The Phoenician in 2020 but COVID forced us to cancel the reservation.  We stayed at The Phoenician in early December and it was just fabulous!  We stayed in a beautiful casita which was spacious, very well laid out with a huge bathroom with double sinks, a large shower with an incredible rainfall showerhead, a separate room for the toilet and a bidet, a large walk-in closet, and a huge tub - you can't ask for anything better than that!

The bedroom had a large, movable flat-screen tv, with a large desk area for my laptop, a separate area for a "bar" area, and had a large covered patio (we were on the 2nd floor) overlooking the pools, a large green space, and the Spa - it was just very eye-pleasing.

Everything in the casita worked perfectly and it was cleaned daily.

We ate every morning at the Cotton & Mowery restaurant and the food was excellent.  I had the pancakes and they tasted just like crepes they were so soft and tasty!  The wait staff was excellent and almost every day we saw Eric Pessin, the manager who was always cheerful, friendly, and remembered our names to boot!!   The really neat thing was to see the Harris Hawk and a handler out every morning ensuring that the local birds didn't bother guests and it was cool even though they never let the hawk go, just his presence was enough to ward off the birds.

The Phoenician staff was also wonderful in remembering that we were celebrating our 33rd wedding anniversary and they had a bottle of champagne and a box of ultra-rich chocolates delivered to our room - it was touching and memorable.

We also had a wedding anniversary dinner at JG Restaurant and the food was outstanding.  

As for The Phoenician resort itself, driving in is real impressive and the magnificent water fountain at the front door is impressive.  We were encouraged to visit the Cactus Garden which we did in the daytime, but we also went back in the evening to see the lighted cactus for Christmas-time - beautiful!  The grounds are very well maintained and it was fun just walking around.

This was truly an anniversary trip that we will NEVER forget!

reviews.text:
Definitely not a 5* experience - more of a 4* experience.

- Had to queue up for about 30 mins to check in as they only had one person at the check in desk.

- Ordered a golf cart to take me to the spa - I had to wait 30 mins to be returned back to the main lobby by the golf cart.

They are clearly understaffed.

- The rooms are very very meh - the mountain view king room was not all that at all - the view was a bit suffocating its exactly like the picture the mountain is really close up its not like a view the mountains from afar kind of vibe. Omni is 100000000% nicer.

- The service at the bar was very poor. The bar staff don't come back to you to take your order, you have to keep trying to get their attention. Our wings came out cold. They forgot our order at one point and we had to remind them of what we ordered - they comped those dishes but definitely not a 5* experience.

The attention to detail was not there as you'd expect from a high end hotel that cost $800 for one night stay.

The view is beautiful from the bar area & the hotel its self is very pretty and scenic - but I wouldn't stay again. I'd 100% recommend going to the omni instead.

P.S. I did have afternoon tea here too at a different date which was fun but I'm British and the sandwiches weren't up to par.

reviews.text:
No stay is without issues but based on overall experience, I decided to give this resort a 4 ⭐️
PROS: Room was clean and big. Beautiful property with great service, nice pools, high quality food and service.
High Tea experience: Good experience but overpriced ($100 per person for 3 course after gratuity and tax)
Mowry and Cotton restaurant: We went to M and C during our stay to eat breakfast and dinner and feel that it’s of high quality in terms of food and service with nice views of the pool. Especially at night the blue light reflecting the pool was amazing.
Thirsty Camel bar: Great bar with nice outside seating area and 🔥 pits. Great drinks and service and live music.
CONS:
-CheckIn experience was not great, things were not explained clearly, for e.g I opted for self parking but no one explained that I could use my room key for in and out from the Self parking. I was paying every time using credit card every time I went in and out. Once I talked to the front desk, they were kind to waive the $23 per day charge they were going to charge me.
-On-site activities: Very few activities for kids or Christmas related events. We visited and attended the Fairmont Princess (a different resort in Scottsdale not associated with Marriott) Resort Christmas lights and ride experience ($72 for 4 with self parking included) and were blown away by the light and kids rides etc. Wish this resort had some nice Christmas lights and more activities for kids. If I had to book around Christmas, I would have booked Fairmont Princess resort just to have access to the Christmas light experience.
-Gym: Far from the property; have to use a golf cart to go there for bike rentals and use.
-Spa: We couldn’t get appointment because it was booked so can’t share the experience however feel it was overpriced

reviews.text: It was thanksgiving giving evening we had a reservation for 7:45 burg they were able to seat us early. We sort of ate at Mowry and Cotton, we got seated and they and waiting about 15 minutes for someone to come up to us finally we ordered drinks then waited another 15 minutes and a different waiter came to take our order. Then we waited 30 minutes for us to finally get bread the after another 15 minutes I asked what is the problem here and he asked if I wanted to talk to manager I just wanted my food! The manager came over and apologize for the wait and finally the meals came out 10 minutes later. The food was not in great condition everything was cold and no one wanted diner anymore. We actually had to get our own drinks at the bar during all this. No one ate there food and at that time we realized we did not even get our soups or salads! So we explained the situation the manager and we just said we wanted our pies. To make up for it he brought us some flatbread pizzas. Needed less to say it was the worst thanksgiving meal we ever had. One for the books!

reviews.text: This resort is very nice and I was happy with the room and view.  However, a few things to keep in mind:  1) shower pressure was not adequate at all; 2) tennis reservations are not organized. Someone was playing on our assigned court at our assigned time. We were given a different court to play on only to be interrupted by the party who reserved that court; 3) the resort does not honor guaranteed late checkouts. As a platinum member I assumed I would get a late check out. When my request was refused- we had to rush packing and checking out of the room (by 11:00am) and it interfered with our plans that day.  This left me with a bad taste in my mouth when we left.

I previously entered in all this information but i was expecting more from a luxury hotel. We had a lovely stay but I noticed things throughout the hotel that I thought would be better maintained at a luxury branded hotel. 

The lounge chairs by the pool were always stained. All of them. And all dirty. I understand that you get towels to cover them but why can’t these be cleaned? They all had bird poop or water stains or other types of stains on them. 

The door entering into mowry and cotton was broken. Why would this not be fixed?? 

Our room was great but I noticed that things were dirty or not well maintained. The tub constantly drained even when plugged. The lamp shade was dirty. When we noticed the comforter had blood on it (not ours) we did get it replaced immediately but upsetting we had to do it in the first place. Some of the new towels also were dirty

The spa and grounds of the hotel were great but I just really was expecting this hotel to be the best fanciest place I ever stayed and it was not.

reviews.text:
I checked in for a four night stay last Thursday 11/15, after flying in from San Antonio, Texas. I booked a stay two months in advance for a one bedroom, executive suite, with a balcony with a resort view. What was supposed to be a nice luxurious stay in an amazing room, to enjoy room service and champagne for my birthday turned in to a total disappointment! The room we were given had zero view. It was a horrible room that faced on all sides the adjacent buildings. No trees, no grass, no garden, no camelback mountain, no saguaro, no pool…concrete buildings! I didn’t book this stay to be in a concrete jungle. The room wasn’t cleaned to my standards, dirty fridge, etc. Lack of decor, very underwhelming. I am not totally convinced they don’t ever use this room for guests due to its condition.

Management repeatedly told me that all rooms were booked solid and they could offer me a measly $400 resort credit for food and beverage. After two nights they put us in the room I assume should have been ours to begin with. After spending $4k for a four night stay at a so called five star hotel, we were taken advantage of and screwed over by management and this hotel. Not a pleasant or positive experience.
reviews.author: Stephanie Perez

reviews.text: Very disappointed as an owner of Marriott.  We were celebrating our 30th wedding anniversary.  They put us on the very other side of the building in the back to look out at a roof top and windows of other rooms across the roof.  We had to walk so far to get to the elevator.  in heals dress for dinner at the steak house on the property, this was not appreciated.  My husband also called ahead to have flowers, champagne and chocolates in the room for our arrival.  They were not there.  He had to call twice to get them delivered.  The room was beautiful and the restaurant was good.
reviews.author: Ang

reviews.text: I received a gift card for $200. The last 19 months with the pandemic we have not spent time traveling or at resorts.  When I called about using my $200 gift card I was told it expired and there was nothing that could be done.  I thought for sure an establishment like the Phoenician was making exceptions considering the pandemic and limited services,  travel,  and all health recommendations. I asked that the representative forward me to a manager so I could explain.  I was within a month of the expiration date.  It did it take Denise, Director of Public Relations and Marketing,  several days,  if not a week to return my call,  but she was listening when she finally did call so I didn't mind.  She asked that I send a picture because gift cards do not expire.  Great,  I didn't mind the delay so much,  however she emailed me shortly after receiving the photo and said this card does expire and they were not making any exceptions  due to pandemic, travel limitations,  and health recommendations. SHE STATED THE CARD WAS "OUT OF CIRCULATION FOR YEARS".  IT WAS JUST EXPIRED A FEW DAYS, NOT YEARS.  DO NOT BUY A GIFT CARD FROM THE PHOENICIAN.  I can't bring myself to tell my husband it was wasted money.

reviews.text:
With ~400 Bonvoy nights and stays at over a half dozen properties in the luxury collection portfolio, this by far the worst property and experience. I would avoid and suggest elsewhere should you stay in Scottsdale (you can get much better for far less). Specifically,
- Am lifetime gold elite
- Checked in on the app as early as available - apprx 24 hrs before arrival
- Had booked and reconfirmed King room
- Requested early check in

When I arrived not only was there no early check-in (which understand it’s only if available) but then they also put us in a room with two queens, see attached photo for our “view”. This hotel’s avg. rate is somewhere around $800 I believe. There was tremendous turnover the day we checked in so I am certain they could’ve found us a king sized room or even a better view (not to mention try for an upgrade, again, part of gold status, but of course also only if available). They didn’t even try. Hospitality is dead

Went to the restaurant while waiting for the room to be ready. Couldn’t even get any server to grab a second beer. I get that everyone is short staffed and trying, but again, you’re paying for “luxury” and this ain’t it.

reviews.text:
If you are used to staying at 5 star hotels, this place will disappoint you.

If cleanliness and upkeep is important to you, stay away.

First room was musty with rotting baseboards (I am not kidding) the toilet also looked like it was coming out of the floor with cracked, yellow caulk lines.

I called to see if I could switch rooms, waited on hold for a while and the person helping me was rude and dismissive. I do not like to complain and I was as nice as possible. 

She basically told me she couldn’t help, I had no options and they would call if they had something for me. ( she never called)

I went to the front desk and was immediately helped and moved to another room.

That room was better, but for a 5 star hotel still very musty and dated. I think because there is no fresh air supply to the bathrooms.

The amenities are like a basic Marriott , but with slippers. The room was above average size, but the usability of the floor plan was average. Location is nice, but several better options in the area.

The staff seemed stressed out. I know during these times places are understaffed, but after staying at several places in the area, I believe it is a choice of management to spread their team thin. Especially considering the price this hotel commands.

Sadly I’m seeing that more and more with Marriott managed properties, hiding behind covid to lower their standards of service.
reviews.author: JonathanP

reviews.text: I recently stayed at The Phoenician Resort last month. Upon my arrival at the valet I was asked if I wanted to leave my golf club set with them and they would hold for me in a storage room and thought that was convenient so I did. During my 5 day stay I did not end up golfing afterall so I never used or asked for my clubs until the day I checked out. When I was given my golf club set back I was missing 3 clubs and my bag was completely rearranged almost as if someone messed with it or used it. I was told I had to file an incident report with their insurance company which I did that has been going on over a month now only to be told that unfortunately they cannot do anything regarding my missing items. Throughout this time I heard from their insurance adjuster 3 times and that is after countless calls and emails I had to make and send over regarding my claim. After reading multiple reviews in scenarios such as mine it seems nothing is ever done nor resolved from either their insurance company or the resort. I had to go through security, insurance and a lot of back and forth with several people only to be told that nothing can be done anyway. Very unpleasant experience during my stay.

reviews.text:
The Phoenician Resort is an incredible experience end to end. We selected Scottsdale and this resort for our 30th wedding anniversary. We are more than happy about the decision. 

The grounds are pristine. The pools are incredible. The Athletic Club has all the amenities needed. J&G Steakhouse served us incredible food and provided impeccable service. Mowry and Cotton was great for breakfast or lunch. The Thirsty Camel bar provided great drinks and a breathtaking balcony view of the pools, the mountains, the moon and Scottsdale/Phoenix city lights. The entire staff was friendly and professional. 

We have been to many resorts, but The Phoenician just made it to the top of our list. We will be back.

reviews.text: Unfortunately had a very poor experience while taking a family trip here utilizing our Bonvoy Points.  Attempted to utilize our Suite Night Awards prior to arrival- Denied.  Inquired about Platinum upgrades available upon arrival- Denied.  Assigned probably the absolute worst room in the hotel for a family with small kids; as far away as possible from on-site parking and the room was level with and only had a view of a concrete roof, absolutely nothing scenic.  Hairdryer in room was broken and curtains wouldn't close all the way and had to be clipped together with a hanger each night.  Front desk said they couldn't do anything about it as they were fully booked and only offered to comp the daily resort fee (which was for amenities we couldn't do with small children, anyway). The "discount" for Platinum members for breakfast at the on-site restaurant wasn't applied to our bill on checkout and now I have to follow up with my credit card company to make sure its eventually deducted... something the Front Desk apparently couldn't do for me.   Extremely disappointed considering the amount of Bonvoy Points spent on the trip and my lifetime Platinum status-  DO NOT STAY ON POINTS, REGARDLESS OF BONVOY STATUS as you'll be treated as less than the standard rate guests.
reviews.author: FlyingJ

reviews.text: The resort is set in a beautiful mountain and the grounds are beautiful but the resort itself, aside from the great lobby, needs updating, especially at this price point. Also, they had events the whole time we were there and our room faced the pool, which was great, but that meant it also faced the corporate events and wedding that were there and were woke up every morning at 5:00am to the noise and clanking of carts, glasses and, dishes being set up. Not cool.
reviews.author: MsHamill

reviews.text:
Front desk experience wasn’t great; was pressured into taking a room far away from where I requested to be for the week. Even after repeatedly asking for a room in the main hotel, the front desk agent insisted that the room offered ‘isn’t far away at all’ - I ended up having to move the next day to avoid a 10 minute commute back and forth to my room. My room request was eventually accommodated, but not without hassle and wasted time on my part. 

In my first room, I found the door to the balcony must’ve been left open as there was a collection of moths and millipedes as roommates that night. The next room had a room service tray of dishes and food left in a closet.

The server in the J&G restaurant one evening loudly chastised another employee who was making too much noise while he was trying to talk to our table; that was extremely awkward for everyone present. I’m also fairly certain he mixed up white and red wine glasses when pouring the bottles. 

Overall, most staff was exceedingly pleasant and helpful but I had the sense that they were mostly new hires and still learning their jobs, which detracts a bit from the “luxury” experience.

Hotel beautiful..location great. Food and serve staff great. Pools lovely!  Plenty of lounges and great staff at pool. 

Con 
No one answers phone. Front desk brisk ..no one explained our bonvoy breakfast etc
reviews.author: R18

reviews.text: A great experience and no need to leave the property.  The amenities on property are spectacular and the food and service at the restaurants was what one would expect from a 5 star dining restaurant.
reviews.author: BillMehr

reviews.text: Great accommodations and wonderful spa. One of the best massages I’ve ever had!
reviews.author: Goldie

reviews.text: Very nice, great staff, friendly and helpful.
reviews.author: RG

reviews.text: The property is nice and well maintained on the outside. Our room had the following issues: 1st, we ordered a room with a poolside view. That's what we paid for. We were told it was not available when we checked in because they overbooked. So we were given another room with a golf course view. When we got to the room the only view we had was a loading dock and some forklifts. And they charged us extra for moving us to another room. 2nd, there was a broken glass on the floor and glass shards in the doorway and bathroom. The sink was dirty and drained very slowly. The cleaning staff left their cleaning materials in the room. At 2pm we finally got our room cleaned. They replaced the shower towels only. No hand towels, no face cloths. We called several times to ask for these items to be returned to our room. We never got them. The service was slow but the service team was nice once you got their attention. The hotel has no shuttle service to take you any where. You have to use Uber or Lyft. The concierge station could not answer a single question for us. They couldn't help get us towels either. And finally the valet team brings us the wrong car causing us to wait even longer to get out of there. No, it was not very busy. It's sad that being the person on crutches standing there waiting for our car that we had to wait longer than any other guest. The food was pricey but very good. Drinks were very good. The rest of the service was no better than a Holiday Inn. Save your money, this place is over rated. Won't be returning.
reviews.author: Ken Crawford

reviews.text: The staff has been well trained! They really made us feel welcome and important. Highly recommend the Phoenician! An awesome experience.
reviews.author: ShauneHudson

reviews.text: Beautiful, well maintained resort. Upon arrival, concierge informed us the spa was not available the entire duration of our stay. Instead of coming up with other suggestions we were given the cold shoulder. Also given the ultimatum of being kicked out of the pool or throw away a fruit cup purchased at the resort Marketplace… Absolutely shocked to see two additional invoices after checkout for “daily resort fees” amounting to another $50/ day. Not up front about this at all and feel like our credit card is an open check book that random fees keep popping up on since leaving. Overall staff experience was “we can help you have a great time but it will cost you $$$”. Not trying to sound cheap by any means but our expectations were to relax and have a good time. It was difficult to do this without shelling money out left and right to the resort we already booked and paid for.
reviews.author: hayden hanna

reviews.text: Love the vibe of this iconic resort, the lobby bar is beautiful and vibrant with people enjoying it. J&G's Steakhouse is as good as any in the area with beautiful decor and views. Mowry and Cotton has great breakfast and lunch. Our room was attended to every day which we have not seen at any other hotel in the last year. Love the multi levels of pools! Even the workout facility has views!
reviews.author: ScottsdaleRegular

reviews.text:
Great staff and room, beautiful grounds.

Some staff at the Thirsty Camel, and the spa, were rude and condescending.
reviews.author: Frequenttraveler

reviews.text: Great location for a girls weekend to getaway, relax, enjoy the area and have fun! Staff were great, the resort was beautiful, the food and drinks were amazing and the area just perfect for some hiking, pool time and fresh non-humidity filled air.
reviews.author: KTM

reviews.text: Beautiful resort at the base of Camelback. Lots of pools, good dining and attentive staff. Don’t miss the tea service. Close to Old Town.
reviews.author: Bryan Clagett

reviews.text: It was a very nice birthday gift from my husband. On Open Table the dress stated Formal Attire. There were many guests in shorts, t-shirts, swimwear cover-ups. I had on dress pants and a blouse before we left for our reservation.  I  changed to a dress before we left in respect to their attire statement. Once we arrived to our reservation, I realized I didn't need to worry that I was under dressed and could have worn my dress pants  and blouse and my new purse, which I was keeping for a special occasion. ☺
reviews.author: Catherine Lopez

reviews.text: Visited for a business conference. Left with a flurry of activities under our belt: swimming, pickle ball, golf, weights, eating and more! Thank f you’re in Scottsdale, this is the place!
reviews.author: Mishan Andre

reviews.text: This was our first time staying at this resort and we were excited because we were celebrating my 46th birthday.  We are well versed to The Luxury Collection brand, but were shocked that this did not live up to others we have visited.  I utilized one of my upgrade nights through Marriott Bonvoy and was pleased when I received the e-mail stating that we were going to be staying in a Casita with king bed, 2 bathrooms, and kitchenette (1150 sq feet).  The casita was very spacious, but we battled mosquitoes and moths in our room.  It was the oddest thing.  The regular shower in the one bathroom was very tiny and gnats were attracted to the faucet in that bathroom.  I was very disappointed in the casita location (1st floor) that was directly looking at construction across the water on the golf course.  We were only at the resort for one night, but I felt like I wasted 60,000 hard earned points on an older property that had dingy seating in the pool areas and one of the two hot tubs was filthy (bugs, leaves, and hair), while the other hot tub was barely lukewarm and full of leaves and a few cockroaches.  We initially left the pool area around 7:30pm to only return around 12midnight to see our pile of towels still sitting where we left them.  We did not see pool towel return baskets and several other guest must have not seen them either as we passed by several towels just tossed over the railing around the pool areas.  Maybe I expected too much, but I wish I had went the less point route and just stayed at the Westin Kierland Resort with a lazy river option.  It was not busy the day we went, so I am not sure why as Platinum Elite members we were not given a better room with a view.
reviews.author: DrRagan

reviews.text: Outstanding experience. Everything from the facility to the dining and service were top notch. Staff members went way out of their way to make us feel welcome and relaxed. Super fun experience. Couldn't find really anything they could improve upon. The guys "nailed it"
reviews.author: MarkS

reviews.text: Wonderful weekend getaway. Very satisfied with every part of the trip.
reviews.author: Dwight

reviews.text: Incredible place, beautiful gardens
reviews.author: Justin Maxwell

reviews.text: Every request that I had during my stay was handled promptly and professionally and always in a friendly manner.
reviews.author: DaveHeney

reviews.text: Great resort in Scottsdale, Arizona.  The Phoenician is large and has several pools, golf course, restaurants and spa. Great views of the mountain.
reviews.author: Javier Evans

reviews.text: We loved every moment at The Phoenician.  The room was spacious and the bathroom was amazing.  Incredible housekeeping service kept  the room immaculate the entire stay.  We were in for a work conference which kept us busy but we did have time to eat at most of the restaurants and the food was fantastic at all of them.  Staff in all areas were friendly, helpful, and went the extra mile to make sure our stay was the best.  We loved it!!  Thank you Phoenician!!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: What a beautiful resort! I stayed here for business, it was comfortable, enjoyable and so spacious! My husband joined me the last couple of nights and it was romantic and we had so much fun at the pool too! The staff was so kind and friendly, I can't wait to come back!
reviews.author: Amber Vogl

reviews.text: Absolutely fabulous experience!

reviews.text: We have our booking to stay two nights and afternoon tea at Phoenician. We called to inform them that we are feeling sick and would like to cancel our reservation and get credit for future dates! The horrible hotel management decline our request! We were just trying to be polite and not spread the germs! They are not good people abd care only about their bottom line! I would not recommend anyone for this incentive and horrible management.
reviews.author: R T

reviews.text: The property is stunning and easy to access via wheelchair. The staff exemplifies the term "customer service". We will be returning to the property soon.
reviews.author: Mario145

reviews.text: Good hotel with adequate service, but not great and not worth the prices.

Rooms looked tired...I aske for a 1:00 check out so I could change after my meeting for my long flight home, which I was denied. Staff seemed put off that I asked for a late check out.

reviews.text: For the price I would have expected more service

I had a great visit and the conference areas were top-notch, not to mention enormous.  This was a fantastic resort to stay in and for the conference, I was attending.  I will be back.
reviews.author: ChadTimmons

reviews.text: Spent 2 wonderful days at the Pool and Spa.  Gennaro took such great care of us at the poolside Cabana we did not want to leave.  Our second day was at the spa Cabana and Brandon picked up right where Gennaro left off.  The hospitality and attention to detail from these two gentlemen made for a couple of great days.
reviews.author: BHill

reviews.text: The Phoenician Resort was absolutely beautiful! The grounds were super clean, the staff was amazing, and the food was fantastic! Although it was extremely HOT, the resort was great! Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Matthew

reviews.text: We loved every part of this property:  valet, check-in, room service, golf, pools, restaurants and more!  Everyone was very accomodating and we were never let down by any elements.  Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Mandre

reviews.text: This facility is one of the best anywhere in the world for business or pleasure.
reviews.author: Scott

reviews.text: Wonderful property and wonderful staff.
reviews.author: SeanMcCreedy

reviews.text: We were completely blown away by the impeccable service and beautiful grounds of the hotel. We were there during Labor Day (it was sold out), but there was never a lack of service (actually contrary) and the layout never made it feel full. We laughed that we were looking to find one rude or unkind person at the hotel or Scottsdale because everyone was unbelievably nice. It was the best trip. It’s been a long time since I have been blown away by a resort and this one did it. The food was delicious at every single restaurant on property… including room service! Also, highly recommend Stellar Adventures for guests. The ATV tour was spectacular and also amazing service. Mitch was our guide and we loved him.
reviews.author: JColeman

reviews.text: The hotel and grounds offer a posh and luxurious experience to make you feel like a Saudi prince. In sharp contrast to the initial impression, you may find that some of the rooms do not offer hot water on demand; you may have to turn on the water taps for 10 minutes before you can begin washing.
reviews.author: RoyF

reviews.text: We loved staying at the Phoenician! All of the staff is so friendly and helpful. The spa was absolutely outstanding, and the hotel bar’s live music took our weekend to the next level

reviews.text:
Your staff was amazing and made this staycation the best it could be.
The level of service, cleansliness was top notch.

reviews.text: Very posh and luxurious hotel.
reviews.author: Roy Firestein

reviews.text: Friendly and great people. Help was greatly appreciated with valet parking, bell hop service and concierge desk made our stay very pleasant.

reviews.text: The resort and staff was amazing! Food, pool, golf course, it all was great!
reviews.author: ChrisColvard

reviews.text: A+++ What a great resort.
reviews.author: Dan Pierson

reviews.text: Luxury oasis in camel back
reviews.author: Lara Shukralla

reviews.text: We have stayed in MANY luxury resorts, Waldorf, Ritz, Fairmont, Kahala...the list can continue.  However, extremely pleased with Phoenician, especially with the STAFF...truly premier-class service!  For example, first two days, we reserved the cabana because this was our long leisure weekend getaway and just needed to relax.  The cabana service was top-notch and extremely personable.  Our last day, we did not reserve the cabana; and incredibly, the service from the staff at the pool is NO LESS than the service at the cabana (of course, cabana has its amenities.)  We appreciate, especially, how our ice-water pitcher was consistently filled and probably the very first resort we stayed where we did not have to request for water to keep hydrated because the Phoenician staff was ensuring our pitcher was filled throughout our stay. The selection of restaurants along with a well-stocked marketplace; and J&G Steakhouse with its beautiful view, delicious well-portioned food and customer service were another value-add to Phoenician luxury resort reputation!  Oh, I've forgotten the beautiful well-equipped state-of-the-art gym along with golf course, tennis courts, a beautiful walking trail and the cactus garden...we will definitely return with our children and our family friends and stay at least a week to enjoy all that Phoenician offers at this BEAUTIFUL LUXURY RESORT!
reviews.author: JGee

reviews.text: The Phoenician is hands down one of the best resorts in Scottsdale. Beautiful location, excellent customer service, great restaurants, and beautiful pools. You will not be disappointed.
reviews.author: NorCalSam

reviews.text: Incredibly friendly, knowledgable and accommodating staff. I will forever remember this stay and will absolutely be back soon!
reviews.author: Elliott

reviews.text: Such a nice place.  Scones with clotted cream was great.  Tea flavors are plentiful and you can get different types of tea throughout your time.  We sipped tea, enjoyed life and pretended we were English for a couple hours while taking in the beautiful resort.  Pricey, but worth doing if you like drinking tea.
reviews.author: James Turkey

reviews.text:
The owners have changed over the years and it is not the same as it used to be. There is a Different crowd and doesn’t feel like the luxurious hotel is once was. Now it’s a party destination for bachelor/bachelorette parties and loud pool parties. The room was a little dirty and the curtains had holes in it. Shower handle kept falling off too. I don’t think the prices of the room match the value you’re getting but the food and staff were good. 

Additionally, all pools were being used 24 hours, which young kids using the cabanas at night. There seemed to be no security. Also, all the jugs of waters that they used during the day were left outside over night. Which does not seem sanitary, same with all the pool towels. 

Sadly, After coming here for almost 15 years, I think it’ll be our last.
reviews.author: AlexJ

reviews.text: I loved this place so so much. I honestly wouldn’t stay anywhere else.  The staff was incredible and the food was bomb. TAKE ME BACK!
reviews.author: Jess

reviews.text: My family and I came to Arizona for vacation. This was our first time at The Phoenician. We couldn’t have asked for anything better. Everything exceeded our expectations, from check in to check out. The staff were all very friendly. The hotel and its grounds were impeccably clean. I would highly recommend staying here, We will be planning another stay.
reviews.author: JennF

reviews.text: I love that the rooms have balcony’s to enjoy the views that surround this resort. My favorite was the well equipped gym! The bed was extremely comfortable! Go and enjoy!
reviews.author: SusanAZRealtor

reviews.text: Beautiful surroundings, attentive staff, great food.
reviews.author: SheriS

reviews.text: Everything was great, service, staff, resort.
reviews.author: CraigK

reviews.text: The spa was all I imagined it would be. The massage tables were the best I have been on.   I was so happy with the plus size robes.  The steam room was large and  relaxing.  The jacuzzi was heavenly.  The staff was attentive.  The waiting room was comfortable and calming.   Room service was delicious.  I do wish there were more choices on the menu.   The pools were delightful. It was hot and maybe some shaded areas over the pool would be nice.  We loved the Cabana. The food there was tasty!  I think the fan made things hotter to me but we enjoyed it regardless. The beds and pillows  were so nice and comfortable!    I was grateful for the golf cart ride to and from the spa.  Thank you for extending my reservation when my flight was cancelled due to hurricane IDA.  I was most grateful.
reviews.author: Cookie

reviews.text: The Phoenician resort is a five star plus property. There is so much to do, pampering, pools and a phenomenal  golf on property that you will not want to leave.
reviews.author: MelReed

reviews.text: We come every August and always have a wonderful time!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Our stay at the Phoenician was absolute perfection from start to finish. The staff was so friendly and capable and the accommodations were absolutely fantastic with a gorgeous view of Camelback Mountain from our window!  Our meetings were capped off by a gorgeous and delicious breakfast at Mowry and Cotton. Efficient and friendly staff were so refreshing!  Not to mention our breakfast was perfection!!!  Thank you Phoenician!
reviews.author: Skaneateles1

reviews.text:
When we arrived we were notified the water slides were closed at 5Pm, although Check-in was at 4pm and the following morning they did not open until 10:30am, with check out time at 11am- the only reason why we booked this hotel was twofold- Water slides for the kids and to be close to the airport for our Departure the following morning...

We then proceeded to go to the two child friendly pools and they were both filthy!! There were cups, pitchers and dirty towels left behind everywhere, debris floating in the pool and the smell that emanated from the bathroom facilities was downright nauseating from all areas of the pool deck. 
Would not recommend.
reviews.author: KellyD

reviews.text: Our stay at the Phoenician was fantastic, from the second we arrived at the resort until the time we left.  The room was amazing and all the staff members throughout the property were very helpful and friendly.  Every request was completed with a smile.
reviews.author: SS

reviews.text: Did not disappoint!  The spa was exquisite…Sharon the best masseuse. Mowry and Cotton was outstanding for breakfast and the service was off the charts. Poolside was lovely. Will visit again!
reviews.author: Lisas

reviews.text: The staff was helpful and the food was good. We ate at 3 of the restaurants and the food was delicious. We especially liked the Tavern where Shirley was most gracious and helpful.
reviews.author: BobbieandQuent

reviews.text: NICE TO GET AWAY BUT FEEL YOU ARE OUT OF TOWN. GREAT ESCAPE!

reviews.text: Need to have coffee in the room
