reviews.text: I live 4 miles away and go to Staycation and enjoy the Luxury of this beautiful Resort. All my friends are now addicted to the Spa. Just glorious. The beds are so comfy and dreamy. The food and shops are amazing. Never disappointed.
reviews.author: Victoria

reviews.text: Perfect location for our mother/daughter getaway. The adult pool, the service, the restaurants…it was beautiful! I would absolutely return.
reviews.author: smsshadow

reviews.text: The hotel is very nice and love that pool doesn't close so you can enjoy a late night swim! The Staff was great!!
reviews.author: SarahBraine

reviews.text:
What was at one time a lovely property has now become a tired hotel/resort in need of an update and joining 21st century. 

No regard for climate change/environment (plastic straws for coffee stirring in the rooms???) and the rooms were very tired, old  and in need of an update (I was in a suite).  It didn’t feel like a luxury property or particularly cutting edge. 

(Poorly made machine coffees for breakfast for insane price)
reviews.author: JZ

reviews.text: Trouble from the start, with the room key and the self parking not working correctly , mini fridge not keeping our items cold enough, to electrical outlets not working in the room, long waits for our drinks poolside, to our Anniversary going totally unnoticed........A few stand outs Nolan at the pool was wonderful, Zach the Bartender at the Main Lobby bar inside and Jamie the Concierge all bright superstars at your resort.
reviews.author: JimmytheGreek

reviews.text:
The property is in a great location. The staff is welcoming and the restaurants offer great food. There are a variety of off property activities and places to go nearby. 
Transportation is available for guests and this property is family oriented.
reviews.author: JessicaA

reviews.text: Came to the spa for our anniversary for our first time and it was absolutely perfect! The guest attendants to the therapist it was an absolute pleasure.
reviews.author: Ivory Stafford

reviews.text: Went to dinner at J & G Steakhouse and checked out the resort. Absolutely beautiful, and we LOVED the restaurant.
reviews.author: Joshua Sittig

reviews.text: Well just to let people know my boyfriend loved it, I wasn't there .
reviews.author: Diane Lentz

reviews.text: We arrived for a quick trip to experience the pools, High Tea, and dining.  The dinner at the J&G Restaurant was delicious and the view was outstanding.  We enjoyed a day at the pool, then an afternoon of High Tea.  Room Service was excellent too.  We preferred to stay in the Villas because they are not as crowded and easy to find our room.
reviews.author: NWCLASSIC

reviews.text: Stayed here for a girls trip and we all had an amazing experience.  The resort is pristine and the service was exceptional.  We mostly relaxed and the staff made it so easy.  As soon as we sat in one of the pool chairs someone immediately brought a pitcher of ice water and towels to us.  They kept the ice water full the entire day.  Just a 5 minute trip into old town for a fun evening.  Very quick and easy to get an Uber/Lyft.  ALL the staff was friendly and helpful.
reviews.author: Pocketgirl

reviews.text: Spa and gyms were great. The pools were ok. We overheard guests talking about urinating in the pool so it turned us off.. also in 5 nights the room was cleaned twice and I had to call around 5pm to ask for that
reviews.author: Nik

reviews.text: It is a great place to getaway with family and kids. Lots of activities offered for the kids and adults.
reviews.author: JRH

reviews.text: Upscale resort with amazing service. The pools are excellent. The main pool has a water-park quality slide and a kids area with different places to splash around and get wet in case the little ones can't swim yet. Also nearby a wading pool. On the second level they have an adults only pool for a more relaxed atmosphere. Finally on the lower level nearest the spa is the Mother of Pearl pool ,which I Iearned ,was actually inlaid with mother of pearl tile when it was built in the 1920's. The staff is excellent!! Very attentive and accommodating. One can reserve a cabana or order meal on their smart phone and truly get the "full service". . money well spent.
reviews.author: Alan Digan

reviews.text:
The property is gorgeous, albeit alittle tattered.   Overall, every staff member I encountered was helpful, friendly and seemed to enjoy their job.   Omar and Sydney out by the pool were very attentive and I was able to take some time to relax by the pool.

My day started with room service and breakfast on the patio looking at Camelback. Unfortunately,  the table cloth had 2 holes in it, one someone had attempted to repair with the wrong color thread.   Really, replace tattered tablecloths.

The afternoon at the pool, resulted in returning 2 towels that had holes in them for different ones. Took a few to find towels that weren't frayed.

I expect all aspects of the luxury collection to be first class, not just the staff. Looks to be like the linens need to be replaced.

The devil is in the details, and its the little things that make the difference.
reviews.author: Pam Bailey

reviews.text: I had a friend who stayed here this past summer and had a bag of clothes stolen out of her room by the cleaning lady’s , no apologies from staff and the way my friend was treated was downright disgusting as if she was the criminal. It’s been 1 month later and she’s still dealing with dissatisfied customer service  and not one employee has offered her any type of complimentary kindness from the Marriott. Corporate was called etc, I live in Scottsdale and I referred these guests there to be treated like this?! , this was nothing but a mere embarrassment and I will and have told anyone I come in contract with as well as employees at the hospital to steer clear of this place , I will never refer ever again another one of my guests  who comes into town to this place. This all could of been resolved had the phonecian had just made my friend feel as if they cared.
reviews.author: Erin Kelly

reviews.text: All staff were excellent at their duties.  Tina at the front desk went above and beyond to help us into an available room.
reviews.author: BL

reviews.text:
In keeping with a great luxury hotel, the food and drink were very well done and the service was top notch. 
The room, hallway and access patio all need help. 
Chipped and cracked tiles, eroding cement, missing and broken hallway doors, frayed carpet in room, patio furniture was dirty and stained.
Realistically, those are small things in comparison to the great "experience" of great service, food, drink and those wonderful pools.  But, when you pay top dollar for a stay- the small things matter! 
We will be back for sure, just hoping the maintenance is done!
reviews.author: ThomasP

reviews.text: Perfect location. Great pool..one for families and one adult pool. Resort is dog friendly!! They also have a great boutique.
reviews.author: Heather Kay

reviews.text: Nice hotel.
reviews.author: Patricia Pertile

reviews.text: Our flight was delayed overnight, we arrived early morning and concierge was so helpful in getting us a room first thing in the morning so we could get some sleep, on site golfing, a wonderful pool area for all ages, the spa is well worth the money (ask for tess if you are getting a massage) restaurants were good, we were given a resort credit via cc rewards to use on site which allowed us to try just about every food option. Would definitely stay here again
reviews.author: Gmavro

reviews.text: Parts of the resort are getting old and tired, but the service is terrific!
reviews.author: Thomas Painter

reviews.text: Fantastic stay. Beautiful grounds. Beautiful upgraded rooms. We ate at many outlets. Food and service was top notch. Spa service and amenities were some of the best we’ve see.  Do yourself a favor and take a stroll around the property. So much to see and take it like orchid lawn and cactus gardens. Talking with many people it has def become more family friendly over the years and less romantic couples. All in all would 100% recommend and would stay here again. Enjoy the photos
reviews.author: Kirk Pope

reviews.text: Booked three nights in a Phoenician Suite, which was huge and nicely appointed with two patios and newly remodeled interiors.  Dined at the steak house (delicous) and had breakfast in the main restaurant twice (nicely decorated and hip menu choices). Pools were enjoyed by the whole family and service everywhere was excellent.  Gym was equipped with all the latest equipment and kept very clean.  We would come back here in a hearbeat!
reviews.author: Rick1300

reviews.text: My husband and I stayed at the Phoenician for 3 nights and had an amazing time. While our trip was short, it was very relaxing and very much what we both needed! The staff at the hotel go above & beyond, and everyone you come across is very welcoming and kind. We spent a day outside at the pool at one of the cabana’s, which I highly recommend! We also ate at the J&G Steakhouse one night, which I would recommend for the views of the valley alone.
reviews.author: Aly

reviews.text: Lovely resort with good amenities.  Excellent pools and exceptional rooms and service.  Highly recommend.
reviews.author: EAP

reviews.text: Excellent!
reviews.author: Yaz Ocádiz ツ

reviews.text:
We had a wonderful long weekend at the Phoenician.  From the moment we arrived with the valet crew and reception desk to our departure.  A special thanks to bartender Don who took great care of us, Christian from breakfast at Mowry and Cotton and to Ben from the spa for one of the best massages I’ve ever had.  The steakhouse was wonderful and we loved our view by the window.  

The rooms were great and we loved sitting out on the patio in the evenings. 

Pool service was a little slow, but Emily was also really great and attentive at the adult pool.  

We truly had a wonderful experience and can’t wait to return for another relaxing weekend at the Phoenician.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: See previous comments, but AC didn’t work well in room, one room stunk of stale smoke, atrocious service, massage therapist told me “you don’t come to a resort for a good massage.” The staff came from a place of “no.” The rooms were subpar. The food was mediocre at best. Every other resort in this price range would be a better option.
reviews.author: Paige

reviews.text: My wife and I really enjoyed our stay at this resort, we loved every minute of our stay. The resort staff were friendly and accommodating, I highly recommend this resort. As for the golf course it was in great condition, and we really enjoyed our round!
reviews.author: Joe

reviews.text: Stay at motel 6 . It’s nicer doesn’t have roaches or leaks and you don’t have to pay for WiFi.  Plus you don’t get injured by glass shards on the furniture. DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY
reviews.author: Pauline Griego

reviews.text:
The lobby: beautiful! Wish it were open to the outside patio so that we could have enjoyed the live music and the outdoors together. 

Mowry & Cotton: we ate here four times. It was excellent for breakfast and dinner. The cocktails are clearly created just for this restaurant. The ingredients were unique. My kids loved their meals each time, chicken and waffles and grilled cheese yum! I had fish both times, we tried several sides and appetizers and everything was terrific. The service was quick. Lots of outdoor seating, which is our preference for August 2021. They had cooling fans outside and misters. They were as well equipped as possible to accommodate outdoor dining in this heat. I appreciated those efforts. The coffee options were lacking. I was surprised they didn’t do cappuccinos or espressos. The coffee wasn’t great. 

Room: our room said pool view but it was just of a large slap of concrete, we could see the back of the kids tree house but no pool. It was room 1136. We liked it’s proximity to the Mowry & Cotton. Restaurant and the exit to the west door, which enabled us to walk down to the pool easily. The self serve coffee tables on this floor was an excellent idea. I liked that they offered a soy option, where as Mowry & Cotton didn’t. 

Pool: this slide is a winner. We have been to tons of resort pools in Arizona and my kids loved this the best. It’s very fast! The food and drinks were great. It was never crowded. I liked the music pumping throughout the family areas. They take serving ice water and towels seriously. Ainsling was a great server!

The spa: I had a great massage. The whole building is truly a full day vacation in itself. I enjoyed the hot tub and roof too pool as well, and had a meal and drink there. It is well staffed. The locker room is too crowded though, women need more chairs and changing space. Everyone was very kind. They were constantly wiping down countertops.  

Covid era visit: 99% of the staff wore masks well. I hope it was optional for the outdoor staff, it was so hot I couldn’t imagine wearing one outside. It all felt very clean. It can be hard to appear chipper when half your face is covered and the stuff seemed very pleasant. 

I am glad we stayed here. My kids already want to go back next year! We will bring friends or family along next time. I do recommend this hotel. Compared to the Ritz it is more grand, perhaps a hair less luxurious but honestly really really nice.
reviews.author: NRK82

reviews.text: Everything was exceptional except for Mowry & Cotton Restaurant (poor quality wait staff and inexplicably long wait times in an empty restaurant) and Room Service (came cold and improperly cooked).
reviews.author: MMitch

reviews.text: First class for rooms, service, dining, spa and the resort overall.
reviews.author: PWalker

reviews.text: I am so pleased with everything, that I’ll be back soon, with the whole family.
reviews.author: TheCouple

reviews.text: Wonderful place to take a vacation!
reviews.author: lloyd sample

reviews.text:
The campus is very well manicured and cozy! Service was impeccable!

No organic food options, had to eat off campus.
reviews.author: AC

reviews.text: We decided to spent our wedding anniversary there. Was great choice. Beautiful location, friendly and welcoming staff, delicious food at all restaurants and room service, multiple options for pools and great choices for activities.
reviews.author: OlgaK

reviews.text: The staff is even better then the resort!! 10/10 everything at all times
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: The resort is impressive. Great dining!
reviews.author: Dan Pierson

reviews.text: I consistently return to the Phoenician for the amazing service, staff and exceptional grounds and facilities. I love this hotel and find that every trip is fabulous! The staff go out of their way to accommodate requests and make you feel extra special. Starting with the front desk and ending with cleaning staff upon departure. Well done! Keep up the great work!!!
reviews.author: IrenePfromToronto

reviews.text:
As a long time guest of the Phoenician, I was thrilled to be returning after a 3 year absence. While still a great property, the Phoenician now is missing the little things that made it unique among the Scottsdale resorts. The exclusive Phoenician scents and products have been replaced with generic Marriott products. Even the new spa has been stripped of its exclusive products. 

I missed the little welcome bag of exclusive Phoenician scents. I miss the fountain in the lobby. You used to enter the lobby, inhale, and sigh like coming home after a long absence. That feeling is missing.

I did appreciate many of the longtime staff have been retained. It was lovely to be remembered by poolside staff such as Rich and spa staff such as Cher. 

I also was disappointed the MOP is no longer the quiet pool. I think this should be returned to adults only. 

Many other returning guests felt the same as I. We were missing those Phoenician touches. It is definitely more of a family resort as opposed to a luxury resort. It may retain luxury prices, but not that feeling of luxury.
reviews.author: TBerry

reviews.text: My husband and I decided to go on a babymoon and picked the Phoenician for their amenities. We were blown away by the level of service and the incredible staff. Everyone went the extra mile to make us comfortable and feel welcome. Would highly recommend!
reviews.author: Jenny

reviews.text: Excellent getaway for our 10th anniversary.  Golf and spa day are a must.  Awesome property, can't wait to come back!
reviews.author: Nick

reviews.text: The Phoenician embodies everything a luxury hotel should have!
reviews.author: VanessaB

reviews.text: I stayed here for a work conference and had a great stay. The staff was very friendly, attentive, and helpful. I don't think I saw one piece of trash anywhere the whole time, the property was immaculate. I only wish our conference was longer so I could've stayed another day. I will definitely be visiting again.
reviews.author: Mary McNair

reviews.text: We stayed for 6 days and all 6 days were great, would definitely recommend and stay again in the future. Has great access to dining, shopping, and beautiful sites.
reviews.author: MiaSwinson

reviews.text: Dirty, disgusting, run down pools that felt like bath water. Weak drinks that cost $16
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: disappointed in the lack of mask mandates in the hotel and lobby
reviews.author: danielle

reviews.text: This is how much the Phoenician cares about 1. its customers, 2. its employees. I have a reservation for the 13-15th however on the 9th I tested positive for covid as did my wife. I tried to cancel my reservation and provided documentation and as you see they refuse and will not refund my money. They stated I can reschedule, I'm about to miss 14 days of work, how could I possibly request more time? With that being said, unfortunately I refuse to lose $940 so I WILL be there this Friday, I will dine in the restaurant I will use the attractions of the resort including the bar and pool. No I am not proud of it, but I will not throw away my mortgage. If I could give them 0 stars I would and I will look into the better business bureau. Avoid this place the weekend of the 13th and at least a week after.
reviews.author: El

reviews.text: I love this place.  So worth the money.  Spent our 25th anniversary here and received a personal note from the staff congratulating us and also surprised us with champagne and dark chocolate covered strawberries!
reviews.author: Glenn Hernandez

reviews.text: While we had a few hiccups some more serious than the others, overall our stay was just what we needed and expected. While some may say the prices for things were overpriced, the portion sizes at all the restaurants blew us away as most upscale places are very skimpy of portion sizes. The gym was one of the best hotel gyms I’ve been to in a while. The only other thing I wish could have been a little better would have been the cabana. With the price we paid it should have come with more amenities. The server was great but it was basically lounge chairs and a covered room. Overall a great resort and would return.
reviews.author: CrystalM

reviews.text: The pool water in every pool the weekend we stayed was an unruly temperature and felt like a spa. We could simply not cool down in water that felt that hot. The staff acted like this was normal but it’s not. Other guests were cutting their trips short because of the horrible pool temps. It’s too risky for me to go back to the Phoenician knowing my entire weekend could be ruined again by the hot pools. Not refreshing or relaxing at all. I felt embarrassed for my guests that we had to endure that all weekend.
reviews.author: JennyClark

reviews.text: Everything was comfortable. The staff was quick to assist no matter where I was in the resort. We will be back
reviews.author: NickBaka

reviews.text: Staff was great, pool needs a renovation. Expensive compared to other similar resorts in the area.
reviews.author: CCamp

reviews.text: Im upset I wasted time and money when I could’ve gone elsewhere for better look, stay, comfort and service.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: So sad that we were only able to stay one night. Everything was amazing from the room to the view of the mountain and the pools. Incredible fitness center you definitely need to set aside time for.
reviews.author: Lovedit

reviews.text: Just stunning and excellent!
reviews.author: lloyd sample

reviews.text: Great hotel in beautiful location. Helpful and pleasant staff. Wish the gym was open longer hours. A bit dusty above the headboard in the room, otherwise very clean. Comfortable room.
reviews.author: Businesstraveler

reviews.text: Our family went on a short vacation close to home due to covid.  I was pleasantly surprised that the Phoenician had so many activities for our family.  Very clean thoroughly enjoyed our mini vacation.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Great place to stay in phx
reviews.author: Brett

reviews.text:
Pool area workers were excellent and hard working. 
Some front desk people were young, inexperienced and very full of themselves.
reviews.author: ArnoldHeller

reviews.text: It was our first time staying at the resort. It far met our expectations. The rooms are beautiful and spacious. The service was impeccable. We rented the pool cabanas for 2 days and Rich was excellent and provided us with the utmost service. The ambience at the pool was pure relaxation. Beautiful resort.
reviews.author: OaklanderPittsburgh

reviews.text:
The Phoenician is an icon of the valley and by far one of the most famous resorts in town. The staff was excellent throughout the stay and made me and my family feel very welcome. The pool is fantastic with many locations whether you are there with kids and want a family feel or want to head over to the adults only area for a more relaxed feel.

Only negative to me is the hotel and the rooms are starting to feel dated. They are still in good shape, but just feels dated. Time for a refresh.
reviews.author: Nathan

reviews.text:
The spa is world renowned and "huge." The vibe is special and intended for a full day experience. A Canyon Suites and spa vacation would not disappoint anyone wanting a special disconnect of pampering. 
Many restaurants to choose from, we tried The Tavern and Mowry & Cotton. There was retail sprinkled in as well, R&R is a fun store. 
The multiple pools were a highlight. High touch of ice water by the pool staff was very appreciated.
reviews.author: CBecker

reviews.text: We had a great time at your hotel. We will definitely return if we need to come back to Phoenix. We will recommend to our family and friends that your hotel is great.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: It’s always a joy staying at the Phoenician.  Great staff, great service, and a great location.
reviews.author: SamarK

reviews.text:
For years I have heard of this property from friends and clients that have been going for years. The property is large and spread out, but access is very easy with golf carts that arrive when you request them.
The spa is world renowned and "huge." The vibe is special and intended for a full day experience. The Canyon Suites with a spa focus vacation would not disappoint anyone wanting a special disconnect of pampering.
Many restaurants to choose from, we tried The Tavern and Mowry & Cotton. There was retail sprinkled in as well, R&R is a fun store.
The multiple pools were a highlight. High touch of ice water by the pool staff was very appreciated.
Joanna Paulsel was a joy and her long history with the property put an impressive cap on the reputation and experience on my visit. There are many long time employees which says a lot for the owners and management.
reviews.author: cyndi becker

reviews.text: I was there for a girls trip to celebrate my birthday. There was champagne and chocolate waiting for me in my room to start. The room was huge and bed very comfortable. The pools were very nice and there was always staff (Victor was our favorite) around to help/take orders for food and beverage. The spa services were excellent with their own private pool on the rooftop. The gym was impeccable and had lots to do there. I would definitely stay there again!
reviews.author: Tianna

reviews.text: My wife and I stayed and the Phoenician for our 20th anniversary and my wife’s birthday.  Our experience was as close to perfect as you could get.  From the spa to the restaurants to the 9 pools they offer, everything was wonderful.
reviews.author: Matty

reviews.text: Zero slow service lost bags lost phone bar never open pool cold and no service. Rooms impossible to walk to.
reviews.author: Guest

reviews.text: Beautiful Resort , well worth it!
reviews.author: Donnarod

reviews.text: The Phoenician Resort is a top tier Arizona destination. I was particularly impressed with the hospitality, cuisine, amenities, service, and beauty of the resort. I highly recommend a trip to this resort if you’re looking for a relaxing getaway.
reviews.author: Amanda

reviews.text:
Great service / staff really strives to make your stay enjoyable 

Hotel common grounds / pool area look tired and need refurb
reviews.author: Walken

reviews.text: Lovely views, excellent amenities. Unparalleled spa. I will be back!
reviews.author: Uche

reviews.text: This was our third visit to the Phoenician in Scottsdale. The first time was magical -- everything was to the highest of standards. The second time was during the pandemic, so we tempered our expectations quite a bit. and to that end, the Phoenician did a nice job of making us feel safe while delivering a luxury experience. This third time, however, we feel the Phoenician fell short. Service was not up to par, especially at the Thirsty Camel and Mowry & Cotton. Steps of service were abismal. Note: the poolside/cabana service remained exceptional. Additionally, due to the rain, there were ceiling leaks in many places throughout the resort, including in the dining area of the Marketplace. No one seemed to be in any rush to fix them. We also had multiple occasions where bathrooms (pool/lobby) were in desperate need of service. And finally, our room had a very pungent scent of metallic mixed with cigarette smoke -- as did other rooms on our floor. In summary, the Phoenician has all the makings of a luxury resort (they have been before), but this experience, unfortunately, really let us down.
reviews.author: BB

reviews.text: The ENTIRE staff at the resort were all so genuine! We haven't seen family or traveled since Covid and this resort treated us all like family and did everything to make us feel welcome!
reviews.author: KParks

reviews.text: We celebrated our 20th wedding anniversary with a romantic over night stay and dinner at J&G restaurant. Everything was beautiful and delicious. The hotel offers extra packages to make your experience extra special and my husband chose a champagne/roses/fruit arrangement to be prepared in our room ahead of our check in. Thank you for a wonderful anniversary getaway experience! Highly recommend!
reviews.author: TraceyO

reviews.text: Excellent value for a 5 star resort. Great service, Food and Location
reviews.author: Brandon

reviews.text: Excellent property.  Would stay again.
reviews.author: CfromMissouri

reviews.text: The Phoenician was incredible. We stayed just one night to relax from a red eye flight from Hawaii.  They let us check-in early to get some rest, and check out late so we did not have to rush.  Mowry and Cotton was phenomenal for both dinner and breakfast.  The activities they have for kids are fantastic, not to mention the pool and slide! The service was top notch and we are absolutely returning!
reviews.author: Stacy

reviews.text: They have the best staff. I love Paula and Patty in the spa and Stacey at the front desk. They made me feel welcomed and knew my name and preferences.  The spa was amazing!! I left all my stress there and floated back and forth daily. Quality staff that was top notch.
reviews.author: SpaWhisperer

reviews.text: Beautiful resort! Camelback mtn cascading over property is stunning. Beverages and food around pool are overpriced. Employees are incredibly polite! Upkeep of game room needs attention ASAP!
reviews.author: Julfa

reviews.text:
Service- exceptional!!
Facilities- Excellent!!
reviews.author: Pfes2

reviews.text: Very nice property with quality amenities! Spacious rooms, variety of food and beverage options and very friendly staff. Will definitely golf on my next trip! Also, close to Phoenix and Scottsdale for day trips!
reviews.author: BluesTraveler

reviews.text:
Excellent stay
Great location golf was excellent course in wonderful shape for being middle of summer
reviews.author: MarcDeBeradinis

reviews.text:
My fiancé and I have been visiting the Phoenician regularly for a couple of years and every time we visit, we are provided with the most impeccable service by Deano at the main bar.
He greets us warmly, provides entertaining conversation and is always attentive in serving us.
In fact, the last time we visited the resort, my fiancé proposed, and Deano played a part in ensuring it all went smoothly!
Deano goes above and beyond to ensure that we always feel well looked after and it never goes unnoticed. We look forward to visiting again and seeing Deano on our next trip.
reviews.author: Eli G

reviews.text:
I have no complaints but nothing stands out in terms of being wowed. When we arrived I was told that the reservation in the system was for the next week. I showed the email that had the dates of the week I was there for. I had originally booked the week prior but had called and changed the reservation about 48 hours after reserving the rooms. The front desk has to get help because they couldn’t get the system to update. No big deal but nothing was done or offered for the inconvenience. I’ve been upgraded at other resorts for less. 

The service too was average. Nothing spectacular and slightly under what I would expect for a “Luxury Collection Resort”.  Again nothing was bad but after having stayed at the sanctuary on the other side of camelback I expected more. I also staid at the Phoenician in 2009 and had an exceptional experience.  Does not seem to have aged well.  I know they don’t get a ton of rain but there were leaks all over the main building our last day there.
reviews.author: Ok

reviews.text: Looks can be deceiving abs this place is just that. Really filthy carpet and room.
reviews.author: AssenethM

reviews.text: I’ve been blessed to have stayed at some of the finest hotels in the world and I can say without hesitation that The Phoenician Hotel and Resort in Scottsdale, AZ is superb. Understated elegance, astonishing spa, beautiful architecture and setting, excellent cuisine, incredible array of classy pools and sophisticated service makes this my favorite Scottsdale Resort. Off season, on, or in between, they’ll make your stay here incredibly memorable.
reviews.author: Steve Sulkin

reviews.text:
Great experience overall. Would have preferred a bit more attention to detail on the part of the housekeeping
staff such as checking what bathroom amenities needed replenishing as well as the coffee and extras selection .
reviews.author: GothamGirlluvsAZ

reviews.text: Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Nathan Rademaker

reviews.text: The staff was amazing. So polite and accommodating. The exterior of the hotel concerned us upon arrival, but the inside was beautiful, updated, and well maintained. Our only real complaint was the temperature of the pools. The water was so warm that it wasn’t refreshing in any way. It felt more like a luke warm bath than an enjoyable swim in the 100 degree temperatures. Aside from the pool, we loved our stay.
reviews.author: LGM

reviews.text: We came for a girls trip & The Phoenician did not disappoint! We enjoyed the service & the different food options, and spent time at the pools each day. The spa was incredible and the service we received at the spa pool was the best of the entire weekend. Worth your money to have a great weekend getaway!
reviews.author: Bre

reviews.text: My best friend recently got married here, and everything from the hotel Itself to the staff were nothing but excellent. The hotel was extremely well organized every detail, for the wedding was well put together and provided for
reviews.author: KeoneW

reviews.text: Good visit overall - great staff and hospitality
reviews.author: JF

reviews.text:
The property is beautiful! The staff were all amazing! 
The food was good, not great for the prices.  The mother of pearl pool needs to be retiled.
reviews.author: AN

reviews.text: This spot was perfect for a long weekend of R&R. I wish we could have stayed longer. The grounds were lovely. The pools were perfect, and the cocktails were refreshing and the staff was attentive and friendly. I will definitely return to the Phoenician.
reviews.author: Tailor

reviews.text: Our host Daphne was amazing ! She helped us find a spot by one of the amazing pools on our first day and then remembered us for the rest of our stay. Like the rest of the staff we met, she was friendly, helpful and clearly loves what she does, which says a lot about the Phoenician. Beautiful spot on the mountain, and left feeling incredibly rested and restored. Thanks !
reviews.author: Jo-Anne Mckee

reviews.text:
Love the Phoenician, have always looked at it as a premier hotel.  We were excited to see all the new renovations so booked staycation this past weekend.  The property is gorgeous, the customer service however was extremely disappointing.
-The Netflix connection is incredibly cumbersome, took over an hour to figure out.  Finally connected and then weak wifi disconnected repeatedly.
-Remote control had to be changed out
-found someone else reading glasses in room, which made us question how well rooms getting cleaned?
-Moury & Cotton Rest.  Front desk staff (Isaiah) was so rude my 10 year old asked me why he was working there.  I asked to talk to mgr and he never sent one over?
-Gift shops have min. you have to spend to charge to room.  I have never seen this before?  They said it was because of Covid?
-They only have 2 people working the operator station, I spend 15 min on hold.  Was so frustrated I had to leave 5 kids and walk to front desk to get issue taken care of?

If you are going for a couples get away it would be great, but if you are looking to bring kids you will leave frustrated.  For us, doesn't matter how many millions you spend to make property great again if staff is rude, and understaffed.

There are so many great resorts in AZ, this one still has a long way to go to becoming premier hotel again.
reviews.author: Chad Archibeck

reviews.text:
The facility is nice, however the nightly resort fee should not be charged especially during the summer months when the amenities cannot be used to the fullest. I wasn’t aware of the fee until the day of check-in and at that time did not have any options to go or stay anywhere else.  

The restaurants on site are expensive and the selection is limited.  The concierge staff were friendly, but not very helpful in providing options on specific things to do in Scottsdale & the surrounding area. Instead they just handed us a number of pamphlets and brochures but didn’t offer any specific information.
reviews.author: CDJ

reviews.text: Disappointed!! The Phoenician has been my hotel of choice for a number of years and it’s not what it used to be yet the room rates are higher.
reviews.author: Happyguest

reviews.text: The resort is so beautiful.  The food at all the restaurants was superb!  it was fresh, creative and delicious.  The pool was inviting and the staff was truly the most friendliest and helpful around.  The grounds were amazing and the overall experience we had was top notch!
reviews.author: SLedda

reviews.text: My husband and I went for our anniversary and had a fantastic time! We got there a little early but the front desk agent, Kaylee, was friendly and we were placed into a room immediately. We were happy (again, we were early) also, she was knowledgeable about activities available for us to try. The man at the athletic club was stand-out-helpful and friendly. Ana Laura at the Tavern was infectiously happy, and the craft beer tasting was ice cold! The room was comfortable, food and drinks delicious, and the little touches made it memorable. We were told Happy Anniversary with a wine and cheese plate delivered to our room, what a wonderful touch! We will definitely be back- such amazing and friendly service!
reviews.author: Shana Medlock

reviews.text: best hotel ever. Great and helpful staff. Clean rooms. Great pool, food, location, and everything imaginable. worth every dollar.
reviews.author: Grayson Baxter

reviews.text: My husband and I stayed here for our anniversary and we had such a wonderful time at the Phonecian Resort! We absolutely loved it! All of the staff are amazing! We had lunch at Mowry and Cotton and it was awesome! We made dinner reservations at J&G’s and it was so delicious and perfect because it was right in the hotel! So convenient! The little market was great for an on the go snack or breakfast. We enjoyed the our time at the pool with their refreshing daiquiri cocktails. The staff at the pool are so nice and helpful. We can’t wait to come back with our kids so they can enjoy the splash pad and the other kid activities. Thank you Phonecian!
reviews.author: KarinaAngeles

reviews.text: My husband and I stayed here for our anniversary and we had such a wonderful time at the Phonecian Resort! We absolutely loved it! All of the staff are amazing! We had lunch at Mowry and Cotton and it was awesome! We made dinner reservations at J&G’s and it was so delicious and perfect because it was right in the hotel! So convenient! The little market was great for an on the go snack or breakfast. We enjoyed the our time at the pool with their refreshing daiquiri cocktails. The staff at the pool are so nice and helpful. We can’t wait to come back with our kids so they can enjoy the splash pad and the other kid activities. Thank you Phonecian!
reviews.author: kangeles27

reviews.text: We LOVE the Phoenician.  The hotel itself is spectacular.  The grounds, the rooms, the views.  All of it.  The servers at the pool were lovely (Veronika, Sydney, Aspen).  The only reason for my "But" is this:  There were no "perks" as a Gold Elite Bonvoy member.  The pool view upgrade we asked for was available, as I went on the website and the pool views were available the whole trip but they told me it was not.  And ok, our room was wonderful anyway but my issue came when our morning flight was cancelled and we were charged 1/2 a day in order to use a room until our evening flight.  The hotel was NOT full, far from it.  As a matter of fact, more than one member of staff (bartenders, pool staff, etc) told us how quiet it was that week.  I really wish they had extended us the courtesy of staying in our room.  As is, I lost 1/2 a days wages, an extra days parking and an extra days rental car.  I would have hoped, as Bonvoy gold elite and as frequent guests of the Phoenician, that they would have done that much for us.
reviews.author: VegasBride

reviews.text:
Went for a drink at the Thirsty Camel Lounge.
The policy is that you give your credit card ahead of getting your drinks. At the time to pay the check, the waiter informed me that they misplaced my card (it was given to another guest, who left with it).
The staff said they would work with security and find ways to retrieve my card. Despite the hotel telling me they would keep me informed everyday of the progress,  I have not received any information and my card is still misplaced.
Of course, I just need to cancel my card and the various recurring payments I have on them and wait for a week to get a new one...but when you take someone credit card ahead of the transaction, you must take all measures to protect it. And when a mistake happens, at least you make your best to support your customer.
Watch out when you go there; you might be charged someone else lunch and lose your credit card.
reviews.author: philippe gaglione

reviews.text: Amazing service and very professional and attentive staff.
reviews.author: Gregg Daniel

reviews.text: We would not stay at hotel again.  Had to change rooms due to stains on couch and carpets.  Second room not much better.  Still stains on carpet, mold in shower, shower head leaked, dirty towels not picked up when clean ones delivered and vent in shower was dirty.  It was disgusting.  Will never stay again…money wasted.
reviews.author: Detta Hern

reviews.text: Great place
reviews.author: Samir Abdeh

reviews.text: My family really enjoyed the property and all the amenities the Phoenician has to offer. We stayed for 4 nights, the room is big and spacious enough for a family of 5. There is plenty to do for kids and adults. Food is good, a little overpriced but what resort doesn’t have overpriced food lol. One thing that is missing is a 24 hour shop or vending machines around the property. If you want a late night snack you better get them before getting to the resort. Other than that we enjoyed our stay. From the pool, to the tennis courts, free bike rentals, game room (my 5 year loved it) to donut decorating activity to the restaurants we enjoyed it all. Will definitely visit again
reviews.author: DrewQ

reviews.text: Excellent stay! Recognized as Bonvoy member and thanked for status. Received all AMEX FHR promised benefits. Excellent room with pool view. Forgot several important and valuable items in room safe. Christina at front desk promptly and expertly coordinated delivery of my things with Saba. Receives them safely at the airport in about 40 minutes time. Grateful. Also loves the pool options (pre-sun up), the variety offered at Marketplace, the on-site retail shops, and the vibe and great libations at Thirsty Camel. Bravo.  I'll be back!
reviews.author: LBR

reviews.text:
While we didn’t have a great experience at Mowry and Cotton, the pool food and service made up for it 
The hotel manager, Mark, was really helpful and compensated us generously. 
We will definitely be back to the cabana at the Mother of Pearl pool!
reviews.author: Guest

reviews.text: The grounds are beautiful.  The dining options were scarce and pricey.  We had an issue with resort credit being taken away.  But otherwise, it was a nice location with beautiful pools and restaurants.
reviews.author: DWeber

reviews.text: Everything about my getaway was excellent.  J&G steakhouse was fantastic.  Gym has top of the line equipment.  I will definitely be back.
reviews.author: Dagmar

reviews.text: Drove from LA to the Phonecian, and was thrilled to see this beautiful property after traveling through the desert all day.  Everything about this place was excellent, from the minute you drive up to the moment you leave.  And it is BEAUTIFUL!
reviews.author: BrianB

reviews.text: As mentioned before, while the food was better than expected and the amenities were great, the awful smells in the hallway of the hotel rooms were so bad for our 4 days, that I can’t in good faith recommend to family and friends.
reviews.author: TG

reviews.text: Very nice place to stay....
reviews.author: Harmon

reviews.text: Good except for the temperature of all the pools - not acceptable
reviews.author: Darla1

reviews.text: Wonderful service and amenities. So relaxing.
reviews.author: Christine

reviews.text: Had a great experience at the Phoenician and would definitely return. The pool was my highlight. In room service food can use some improvement. I ordered Salmon for dinner and it was not as appetizing as I expected. Otherwise, great experience overall.
reviews.author: Akei

reviews.text: I loved every moment of my 3 night/4 day stay. The property and service was impeccable. All the drinks and food options were delicious. The spa is a must try. I truly felt like a Queen the whole time!
reviews.author: EllenElizabeth

reviews.text: Loved my stay here especially with our privacy, usually at other hotels guest come up for pictures but everyone was polite! Can’t wait to come back
reviews.author: BK

reviews.text: It has become a family tradition to have staycations at The Phoenician for various holidays (i.e. Easter, 4th of July, etc.).  During the pandemic everything was very subdued after The Phoenician reopened, but this year they were back in full swing.  The staff seemed well-trained, motivated, and pleasant.  It was a fun and relaxing time.  The property seemed to be well-maintained and ready for guests.
reviews.author: Bart

reviews.text: an excellent experience and visit.......regular visits over the years and the Phoenician always is consistent and excellent by all global standards
reviews.author: david

reviews.text: Amazing hotel, the pool was nice and warm in November.
reviews.author: Alex Danaila

reviews.text: We thoroughly enjoyed our time here at The Phoenician. It was one of the nicest resorts my husband and I have ever stayed in. Service was amazing. Amenities were all top notch. Everyone we met was so kind and went above and beyond to help us or to fulfill our requests the whole time we were here. They made the whole stay so convenient that we never had to want for anything. Whenever we are in the Scottsdale area, we will absolutely be staying here again!
reviews.author: Christine

reviews.text:
This review is not complete because of the word limit
First and foremost I want to start off by saying my partner and I were celebrating our anniversary and chose this “luxury resort” as a form of stay-cation to relax and enjoy our years of being together. For the money we spent for a single day and night at this resort I am EXTREMELY disappointed, and it truly all began from the moment we drove up to check-in. The valet was a mess, no one would even bother to help us with our bags or car so we ended up parking a distance away from the front desk and walking, with all of our things, to check in. So obviously irritated already, it was no shocker that we were told our room wasn’t ready and we could give our bags to some bell hops if we wanted to while we waited. I informed the man who was checking us in, Corey I believe (?), that we had a treatment at the spa that day and wanted to wait and relax there until we were able to go to our room. He assured us that wouldn’t be a problem and we could give our bags and car to the valet and they would shuttle us to the spa. HA! When we told this to the valet they informed us that it “actually will be quite a while before anyone can shuttle us” so we’re better off driving ourselves to the parking garage by the spa. Of course, who’s surprised at this point. Also I told the man checking us in that it was our anniversary and if it was possible we would love a cooler and champagne glasses available in our room when it was ready. All we had asked for was two glasses and some ice and you would’ve sworn we were asking for the entire complex on a silver platter by the way he looked at us. He flat out denied us and told us we can call room service once we were admitted to our room if we still wanted that - no congratulations, nothing. Thanks, five star service indeed I guess. So my partner and I drive ourselves down to the spa, which was the single enjoyable part of the day. I truly do not have anything negative to say about the spa or the staff. They were incredibly accommodating and we immensely enjoyed not only our couples massage, but the cabana we rented on the rooftop that day…. And then our nightmare began again. When we left the front desk from checking in we were told we would receive a call that our room was ready, at the latest 4 pm…. It was 5:30 when we left the spa and we hadn’t received a call or anything. also I should say that the spa staff repeatedly asked us for our room number and it was pretty embarrassing to have to say we had no idea because, you guessed it, no one had told us a thing about our room or when it would be ready! So we leave at 5:30, drive ourselves back to the front desk, where once again not a single person asks to help us with our car so, once again, we park a distance away and walk to the front (same old song and dance huh). We’re finally handed our keys and told where the room is. And guess where it is, right. Next. To the spa. Where we just came from…. So how many unnecessary trips did we take just to drive ourselves right back to where we had came from. Oh and can I add that no bell hop dropped our bags at our room for us, they just handed them to us from where they were being stored and we were of course on our own again. So naturally we decide to dine away from this egregious, disappointing resort. Best part of the evening truly. We return around 9 and start winding down from the day. Around 11 pm, our neighbors decide it’s a FANTASTIC idea to invite all six of their friends they’re visiting the resort with out onto their balcony which is directly next to ours with no walls between. We could hear (and smell) EVERYTHING. They were screaming until 1 am. We called the front desk TWICE to complain and they assured us they were sending security to handle it. HA, for a second time! Trust me, we would’ve known if security had bothered to knock on their door because we could hear every. Single. Word. They were saying and I think I would know if one of them had
reviews.author: Rachel Carroll

reviews.text: We had a fairly mixed experience at The Phoenician during our 9-night stay. The hotel property is very nice and looks beautiful. Pools are nice also, except way too warm. I would think a hotel of this caliber can afford some pool cooling equipment as getting into a 95 degree pool is not pleasant when it is 115 degreed outside. Service by the pool was pretty good though. Rooms are fine, nothing special, but our towels were dirty. Calling for help/front desk/service required a 5 min wait on hold every single time. Would you expect this from a 5-star hotel? Front desk service is also terrible, there was always a long line and the people at the front desk did not appear to have much interest in helping anyone. For example, when checking in, I was told my room was not ready, no other rooms were available and I just had to wait. Yet, literally 5 min later a room was given to another person we knew (same room type as ours, same length stay). So how was no room available when I was checking in and miraculously appeared 5 min later??? My room keys stopped working one day (after the front deck people tried to enable them to work in the parking garage) and I had to stand in line for 20 min to have their mistake fixed which made us late for a tour. Parking garage is too small and tight and was supposed to work with my room key (which only actually worked twice and was broken the rest of the times). Food options are also very limited on property and prices are outrageous. We ordered breakfast for 4 people once and it cost $150 (for two orders of eggs, one order of pancakes and one order of waffles, with two orange juices and one coffee). Overall, not a completely horrible stay, but I would not return to this hotel (and I am a Bonvoy Lifetime Platinum member).

reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: From the moment that we checked in, the high end/high touch experience that the Phoenician resort gave us was phenomenal. We were celebrating our anniversary weekend, and for those around the resort who were aware, they went out of their way to wish us a happy anniversary and to make our experience even nicer. One night we returned back to our room to a bottle of champagne and chocolate truffles which was amazingly unexpected and appreciated.
reviews.author: MelodyF

reviews.text: Beautiful resort, amazing responsive friendly staff.  Dining options were excellent!  Areas for improvement for a resort of this caliber - kids in the adults only pool; loud party on terrace until 2:00 AM; better attention/upkeep to room amenities.
reviews.author: Scott

reviews.text:
Phenomenal service all around! Thank you again for such a lovely stay. Also, thank you to the pool attendant Martin. He truly went above and beyond every time we were
at the pool. We will definitely be back!
reviews.author: Shereen

reviews.text:
If you’re looking for a breathtaking view, exquisite dining, an adult only pool and convenience the Phoenician is a must. We loved our stay! 

Heather 
New York
reviews.author: Heather

reviews.text: My stay was great as always, but today I am writing about Andrew.  I had been trying to reach a department for over a week with no success.  Andrew explained why I hadn't gotten a response and immediately got the information to get this resolved.  Great attitude and work ethic.  Work ethic is hard to find today so kudo's to you Andrew.  Keep up the great work!
reviews.author: BigDaddyK 1275

reviews.text: This was our first family trip since the pandemic started and I must say it was a memory to by remembered! I am grateful to the staff and service we received at the Phoenician and the kindness that was displayed during what still is a hard time. The only thing I would suggest is to spray more for spiders and insects in the rooms as we had a few in our room throughout our stay. Other than that it was excellent!
reviews.author: KatieMK

reviews.text:
Place was great. Pool gym service and all the stores in the hotel was excellent. 
Food delicious where ever you ate. Coffee at the market store was amazing bought a bag home with me.
reviews.author: Reddragon

reviews.text: We love the resort. It was clean, the food was good, and it was beautiful.
reviews.author: NLP

reviews.text: This place has superb staff and that is the main reason to come
reviews.author: Romeo

reviews.text: Amazing customer service!  My daughter and I had the best time relaxing pool-side, enjoying the spa and savoring the yummy food in celebration of her 8th grade graduation (and a challenged year).  A special time with my 14 year old made more special by the great care by each Phoenician team member! Thank you!
reviews.author: GenLong

reviews.text: Our stay at the Phoenician was excellent.  A beautiful property that is family friendly.  The staff is so welcoming and attentive.  They go above and beyond to make your experience wonderful. We can’t wait for our next visit.
reviews.author: Familyoffour

reviews.text: Best vacation I have even been on. Everything about the resort was ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️. Food, service and cleanliness was above and beyond
reviews.author: LexxFrys

reviews.text: I had problems trying to book a stay there, haven't even stayed there yet.  The first time I called I got cut off because I was on hold so long, second time I called same thing, so I called later then 3rd time I called the gentleman told me that there beds were made of feather when I told him that I was allergic he said then I guess you would have a problem staying here. I called Marriott because I thought that was weird and they checked into it and it wasn't true just the pillows and duvet had feathers, so I called back to try again and make a reservation.  I asked if we could get a room by the entrance and restaurants because my husband has a leg injury and cannot walk far with his cane and she said that did not have a room close to the entrance so she put us in a casitas room furthest away from the lobby and said she cannot guarantee anything, ask for a feather free bed due to allergies said she would put it down a request it but can't guarantee it.  After I hung up I realized this doesn't seem like good customer service practices so I called back to talk to a manager, they took a message after listening to my long story and said someone would call me back to help me with this situation and it has been 3 days and nobody has called me back.  I just cancelled my reservations. Terrible customer service!
reviews.author: reikimasterteacher1

reviews.text: The Phoenician is the destination while in Phoenix. All comfort and luxuries if you are visiting for business or leisure.  The Garden, presenting the flora of the desert is simply amazing. Restaurants and bars to delight you at any time. The Spa and pools to relax you when needed.  Loved it! Montserrat
reviews.author: Montserrat Hernandez

reviews.text: This is a fabulous Hotel the swimming pools provide enough room for adults and children and nobody is in each other's way the staff serving drinks and food are marvelous friendly and always there when you need them and besides that they're always filling up ice water pictures wherever you're sitting in providing plastic cup so you always have water when you need it I can't say enough positive things about my pool experience at The Phoenician this 4th of July it was simply absolutely fabulous
reviews.author: David Rosen

reviews.text: I expected more from a luxury property. We were there for a dance convention and finding food that was agreeable to kids and available when they were done dancing was a huge problem.
reviews.author: TD

reviews.text:
The staff were welcoming and helpful, well appointed for this property.  The hotel was beautiful (per usual), and seemed to be mindful of the pandemic with cleanliness.  We really enjoyed our cabana and would recommend this option for groups (instead of fighting for chairs). 
Other than the atrocious service at J&G, the other restaurants’ food & service were on point.
reviews.author: Rachelle

reviews.text: Room booked not available, Anniversary plans ruined, Complimentary ride offered to us but the company driver were asking me to pay for both ride to and back to the hotel for my anniversary dinner......  I had to be calling the front desk to try and resolve the issue. Just overall disappointed with my entire stay. I expected better
reviews.author: M

reviews.text: Stayed at the casitas and the quality of the room was bland.  No pillows at the sofas and damaged door frames/walls.  The place was clean and the facility was nice and has lots to offer.  But over priced compared to other resorts.
reviews.author: Wolveriner

reviews.text: Don't know just working on expanding the place
reviews.author: Bobby Valdez

reviews.text: THIS IS THE MOST INCREDIBLE PLACE! Stayed for a babymoon with my husband and the service could not have been better. The staff everywhere is so friendly and helpful. The amenities are top notch. Food everywhere we went was very good. I wasnt expecting much with the food since it's a resort, but it was great! We could not have enjoyed this stay any more!
reviews.author: Allie Fantin

reviews.text: Was impressed for the event. That we went to  nice staff parking was a pain for handicapped people    no easy access for wheel chair people also difficult to find Access
reviews.author: Mike Szymanski

reviews.text: Lovely resort.  We stayed for 4 nights after time in Sedona and the Grand Canyon.  I was happy that there were some healthier options for breakfast (Acai bowls) and at the pool (the grilled vegetable kabobs were great!).  We stayed on points and did receive an upgrade to a pool view which was nice as the resort was not extremely busy.  We used the gym once, it was large and fully equipped.  We also used the pickleball courts and bikes.  The $50 per night "resort fee" irks me and the fact that it includes use of the courts but you have to pay for your balls is also ridiculous.  They need to fix that.  Other than that we greatly enjoyed our stay. Another note:  children eat for half price off of the adult menu.  This was huge as my 10 year old generally eats an adult meal now.  Each meal the server "forgot" to charge us half price until we reminded him, so just be on the lookout for that.
reviews.author: kstevens001

reviews.text: Fabulous hotel. We loved the room, service and food. Marriott, please start minimizing the plastics you use! The poolside non-recyclable plastic cups were ridiculous... it is so easy to make the switch to compostable. Also, in room amenities, please make the switch to high end soaps in refillable pump containers. Small and easy step to make a big impact.
reviews.author: JLPortland

reviews.text:
30 years ago I had been driven onto the property for a quick look.
Finally a lovely surprise gift for my birthday a  2 nights getaway.
For some reason I had thought The Phoenician would have been more elegant and from the old world of luxury hotels. It is basically a facility offering pleasant surroundings for the commercial crowd. Nice but not measuring up to the hype.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Very nice and well maintained facilities. The staff is super-friendly and we always felt well taken care of throughout our stay (family vacation).
reviews.author: AlfredH

reviews.text: Very relaxing and exactly what was needed starting to travel again after COVID.
reviews.author: Kelly

reviews.text: Great resort, beautiful landscaping at the base of Camelback Mt. Definitely 5star
reviews.author: Brian Foley

reviews.text: Beautiful place for to go with your family.
reviews.author: yessenia portillo

reviews.text: For five stars I expected more. Definitely not as family friendly as was hoping. Nice place to be if you want quick access to Scottsdale downtown and restaurants. Could use some updates as well.
reviews.author: Elizabeth C

reviews.text: Lo mejor de lo mejor recomendadisimo.
reviews.author: vero sedillo

reviews.text: Great resort for work meeting with lots of things to offer outside of business meetings!
reviews.author: PLW

reviews.text: The quality of some of the food didn't quite meet the standards of a high class hotel, especially for the price. Otherwise, the standard room is spacious with a big TV and bathroom/shower
reviews.author: David Reil

reviews.text: Love it!
reviews.author: Ms Cynde

reviews.text: Beautiful resort with just about everything you need in one area. Customer service was great. Pool area and grounds were exceptional. Gym was beautiful. Rooms in the main building were a bit outdated, but nice and big. Beds were comfortable. Bathroom was huge. My only complaint was the shower. Shower head needs to be upgraded bc water flow was not smooth n consistent. Overall a pleasurable stay. Entire staff was excellent!!
reviews.author: BusinessTraveler

reviews.text: Vanessa (front desk) & Kevin (with a nickname I can't remember - shame on me) (bellman) and the catering staff too.... overall, just great people working on this property.  Friendly, smiling, helpful made us feel well taken care of!
reviews.author: Fox

reviews.text: We had our company meeting here and it truly felt like we were on vacation rather than at work. Extremely clean and every single staff member was courteous and accommodating from the second we walked in until the day we left.
reviews.author: Laura

reviews.text: This is an amazing hotel.  We had a staff meeting here and it made the meeting extra special
reviews.author: Scottsutherland

reviews.text:
We had the most exceptional stay! First and foremost, the resort is beautiful and  clean. The entire grounds is beautifully unkept. 
We got to the hotel way earlier then check in and we were able to get a room. The receptionist at check in was so kind, friendly and helpful! We also got a later check out which was so nice. 

The room was spacious, clean and had a very comfortable bed! 

The pools were great! The workers who helped set up your chairs were phenomenal! You didn’t even have to ask them for help. They just did it. 
The servers were all so great, specifically Berkley who we had two of the days. She went out of her way to provide the best service and experience. She made us dinner reservations and even found us our drink that was out at the bar. 

Food was so great! There wasn’t a bad meal that we had. My husband said the steak house had the best steak he’d ever had. 
The bar in the main lobby was great. Don was amazing! 

There isn’t one bad thing I could say about our stay. We will be back and we plan to bring our kids!
reviews.author: Katie

reviews.text: We keep coming back because it's such a great atmosphere!
