reviews.text: Visited The Phonecian from Seattle. Spent 5 nights. Enjoyed every moment from the restaurants to the pools. Highly recommend this resort to anyone.
reviews.author: KatieandWes Y

reviews.text: This resort is a great spot for out of state travelers or even for a staycation! my two girlfriends and I spent the weekend at the resort for a summer staycation. We laid by the pool, enjoyed the various restaurants on property, and ventured over to Old Town Scottsdale for a dinner out on the town. The resort itself is beautiful and clean!
reviews.author: Kate

reviews.text: Still under construction for the part I went too. But just a beautiful place non the less. Wish I could afford it!
reviews.author: Norm Mahoney

reviews.text: Muy agradable y muy buen servicio en todo momento 👍
reviews.author: ELEDELMO REYES

reviews.text:
The resort itself is very beautiful. The staff is so nice and very attentive. The amenities like the gym and fun activities around the resort are pretty great. 

The price for food though is crazy to the point it's tacky. Like I paid the same amount for food in 3.5 days I was there as I did for the rooms. The restaurant food was pretty good. Almost worth the price (minus the excessive amount charged for drinks), but the marketplace is horribly overpriced. If you just want a quick easy snack you can expect to pay $4 for a tiny yogurt that would normally cost $1 at the grocery store, $15 for a breakfast sandwich that I'm pretty sure they just microwave beaded off of the hard croissant and $7 for a gross muffin and mediocre coffee .

I went in really expecting a 5-star experience and didn't fully get that. I probably will try a different resort the next time I'm in town.
reviews.author: Bslc

reviews.text: One can't beat the views at this Scottsdate resort and the multiple pools meet the preferences of every visitor. One highlight of the pool service is that staff members deliver pitchers of water to your group throughout the day, which is essential in the desert heat.  The best part of the stay was visiting the Phoenician Spa, which was indulgent and relaxing.  In addition to that, the staff were very friendly and accomodating.  The disappointing part is how run down much of the furniture is throughout the seating areas.  Stained cushions, ripped pillows and dirty surfaces don't mesh with the upscale stay The Phoenician claims to offer.
reviews.author: Kristi

reviews.text: This hotel and the service provided was excellent, the casitas are not or at least the grand deluxe with fire pit, that we had was not. The room dirty and we even found a dead bird right outside on our porch by the fire pit…yuck. The room was small for what your asked to pay, especially when compared to other “regular” rooms.
reviews.author: MichaelBeshay

reviews.text: One of the best resorts my wife and I have ever stayed at. The entire staff from the reception, valet, pool staff, bar and restaurant staff and the spa staff were ALL amazing.  Very attentive to our needs. We can not wait to return.
reviews.author: JM

reviews.text: I enjoyed the ease of the stay.  Quick to get into room and fast to the amenities.   It was a great stay.  Self parking was super easy.
reviews.author: Rick

reviews.text: Overall excellent resort, vacationed with children. I only wished they had more children’s food options.
reviews.author: Jeanette

reviews.text:
Overall our experience was good 
We had dinner at J&G steakhouse was excellent. Enjoyed our breakfasts every morning during our stay. Loved the two clothing shops at the resort, bought some really nice outfits.
reviews.author: Laila

reviews.text: The rooms were not well cleaned daily by Housekeeping. The bathroom floors were never cleaned. Had to request shampoo and soap several times. Coffee bar was not always stocked. Thehotel under Marriott has gone downhill in my opinion on cleanliness. The pool lounges are stained and dirty. The Executive Housekeeper needs to get his staff to perform their work to meet standards. Rooms also need to painted as there are chips in the walls. I don’t think after many stays at the Phoenician that I’d rate this a 5 star resort.
reviews.author: ArizonaBoundGuests

reviews.text: We had a brief stay at the Phoenician on our way to Sedona. The Hotel remodel is nice and the food is always good. It was very crowded and difficult to get chairs at the pool. The grounds are well maintained but the hotel still still seems dated after the upgrades. Overall a beautiful place and location but overpriced for what it has to offer.
reviews.author: Antpalm21

reviews.text: Everything was wonderful; food was excellent only had one incident where one of the weight staff was a little rude but she seemed overwhelmed at the moment.  Overall great stay, I was here on business but I would definitely go down for a spa weekend soon
reviews.author: Cristina

reviews.text: To be honest our stay was disappointing. For a luxury resort, we repeatedly were let down with service issues. The staff did attempt to make them right on a few occasions but we had multiple issues. To begin with we booked a pool view casita. When we first got into our room, it was NOT a pool view casita. it was on the backside and only had a view of the road. We immediately called guest services and were told that they did not have any pool view casitas available and that we would have to move the following day. This was a major pain! Then my wife walked in to the bathroom to a broken toilet. Not a big deal but just another inconvenience at a 5 star resort. Later that evening my wife spoke with guest services again in an attempt to cheer me up by ordering some champagne and strawberries to be left in our room as a surprise, but unfortunately the employee she spoke with put down the wrong room number so it was never delivered. When my wife called to ask about it they apologized and said we wouldn't be charged for it...... and then they hung up on her. I would like to say this was the end but unfortunately it was not. The other couple who came with us booked a pool cabana for our last full day at the hotel for the four of us to enjoy. The day before we were to have the cabana he went to guest services again to see if the cabana location could be changed. I was right there when the customer service rep said they would look into it and try to change it for him. The next day when we showed up to enjoy our cabana we found out she had cancelled the original one and never rebooked and that they were now all booked for the day. Individually, we understood all of these incidents and did not complain to much, but on the whole it made our trip to the Phoenician a major disappointment for the prices we paid and for the reputation of the resort. I would highly caution friends who were traveling to Scottsdale to consider other options.
reviews.author: JCurtis

reviews.text: We really had a great time at the Phoenician! Impeccable grounds , great athletic club, delicious food, courteous staff and wonderful landscaping.
reviews.author: VanitaPanjwani

reviews.text: The resort was beautiful and for the most part we had an amazing experience…….until checkout. We had a late flight so I bought the spa package that included late checkout and we could enjoy the resort for the only day we were there. I went to the front desk to ask when check out was and she told me 11:00 which is regular check out. I asked what about late check out that came with the spa package I purchased. She talked to someone behind the counter then told us that’s only as available and we would have to check out by 11. She told us the gym showers are available and we can leave our bags with the bellman if we wanted to go to the pool for the day. She wasn’t rude but just felt like she either didn’t know how or cared to accommodate the situation. It was pretty frustrating since that was the main reason I chose the Phoenician and paid extra for the spa package which we didn’t use either. I will more than likely try valley ho next time we’re in Phoenix.
reviews.author: CaseClough

reviews.text: Excellent service, awesome pool, expansive rooms! Great for couples, families or a group of friends! Book spa appointments in advance.
reviews.author: Paige

reviews.text: Absolutely loved our stay here! The staff, food, and service was impeccable! Would definitely come back!
reviews.author: Monica

reviews.text: My wife and I stayed over Memorial Day weekend. Everything was amazing. The food, service, pools, golf course, gym, everything. Definitely would stay again.
reviews.author: NateF

reviews.text: The Phoenician did not disappoint! Every staff member was a joy to speak to. The rooms were spacious and updated. Pools were very relaxing. The food was some of the best I ever had. Top notch athletic club. The only suggestion is that if you want to use the spa or have a poolside cabana, be sure to make a reservation beforehand! They do fill up fast.
reviews.author: David Wickenhauser

reviews.text: Excellent hotel and resort. But a bit pricey for a one stay.
reviews.author: MohamadELSafah

reviews.text: See a bove. No need to repeat

A beautiful resort in the Arizona Desert. We've been staying here for our late summer/Labor Day weekend vacation for the last 15 years and this Memorial Day Weekend did not disappoint. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: sonnie512

reviews.text: Would stay here anytime.  Every aspect of the stay was wonderful.
reviews.author: Bill

reviews.text: Beautiful property but the staff was incredible.
reviews.author: Freddie

reviews.text:
Extremely poor service standards. 

- On day of departure, housekeeping staff unlocked our room and walked in without knocking & waiting for us to respond first, twice, well before our designated and confirmed check-out time

- Titanium Elite welcome gift choice was not proactively offered at check-in. Upon enquiry, front desk said they'd send breakfast vouchers up to the room, on three separate occasions, but still didn't happen after three days

- Service requests are fulfilled extremely slowly. A simple request of getting a set of knife & fork to the room took 45min and 2 phone calls
reviews.author: NZAA

reviews.text: I have been saying at this resort since I was a very little girl. Oh how disappointed I am today as I check out with my family. The quality of service was so poor our stay from housekeeping to the wait staff by the pool, at the restaurants even at the bar in the lobby. When our room was made up it was done so haphazardly that look like my children made the bed. Anytime we sat by the pool we had to wait forever to get anyone to come and help us. At the restaurants the servers had to be asked at least three times to get some thing as simple as a glass of ice. On check out day I called and called the bell desk, the front desk, and the operator and got no answer for at least 30 minutes. I even called from my cell phone the outside line to the hotel and did not get through. What a disappointment! At one time this was such a premier resort and the way that we were treated this time made me feel like I was at some unrated hotel.
reviews.author: nichole hughes

reviews.text: As a Gold Member and card holder I used my points for a reservation for a king room with a view as a surprise for our anniversary. I was shocked upon entering our room to find a concrete roof along with pots of dead plants and dirt as our view. A phone call to the front desk resulted in a conversation with a staff person indicating that I bought a room at the entry level of their rooms. I explained I was using points and she indicated they were booked and couldn't provide an upgrade. I explained that I had booked a view and she asked if I had proof of that in email or text. I was not about to hunt on my phone through messages for a reservation made weeks earlier. I stated it should be in my reservation. She repeated that this was the room I had for the reservation. I was at this point more than upset of how our anniversary evening was starting with the condescending view of our reservation by the hotel. Thankfully drinks, and later dinner, was lovely but I wouldn't recommend using your earned points at this establishment. You'll be treated as second class guests.
reviews.author: RevDMarie

reviews.text: Hotel was beautiful with one of the best views in Phoenix. Room was big, updated and very comfortable. Staff was EXCELLENT! Very friendly and always accommodating.
reviews.author: MaiB1502

reviews.text: Good hotel. People are nice. Just don’t go there for your anniversary. They won’t give you anything even if you tell them.
reviews.author: Vp

reviews.text: Beautiful!!!
reviews.author: Linda Volheim

reviews.text:
The grounds in the resort are beautiful and well kept. Plenty to do for everyone: tennis, yoga, gym, golf, several swimming pools, activities for kids. The cactus garden is gorgeous as well and makes a great backdrop for pictures:). The resort is so large that it never felt over crowded. 
The Thirsty Camel ended up being our favorite cocktail lounge in Scottsdale: delicious drinks and stunning views! 
 Hotel staff was quite pleasant except some of the wait staff at the breakfast restaurant, definitely not 5 star hotel servers (indifferent, almost rude and service was slow)
The housekeeping could use some improvement as well: we had to call for extra shampoo and soap but didn’t get it and had to call and ask for it again the next day. Nightstands and dresser was very dusty as well and sinks and bathtub weren’t cleaned during our second day stay. 
Food... was disappointing. Too much salt and everything was drenched in butter. Maybe it’s Arizona thing. 
 Overall though, we really enjoyed our stay and glad we picked this resort!
reviews.author: YuliaN

reviews.text: Truly wonderful time at amazing resort with attentive staff.
reviews.author: jHItraveler

reviews.text: Horrible overpriced room! Dirty, dated, spiders. Flat, lumpy pillows. Rough dirty looking towels. When we asked for new pillows, they dropped them off on the floor of our room when we were out. AC was not working as well as it should. We asked for a discount - they gave us $50.00. What an insult!  Beautiful and elegant outside premises/ I guess it does not matter about the quality of the room.
reviews.author: Carmen Zuniga

reviews.text: Very enjoyable time. Would go again
reviews.author: BilboBaggins

reviews.text:
Rooms need updating and if you book a Casita make sure you don't get one that backs up to the parking garage.   
Staff is great and my spa treatment (scrub and massage) was outstanding but I don't think I will visit again.
Its a good resort for parents and since I was traveling with family and small children it was a decent stay.
reviews.author: MJS

reviews.text: The Phoenician is an excellent resort for the value and extensive amenities.  The pools, spa, fitness center and golf check all your needs off the list.  Even in the COVID world, we felt safe and the resort did everything to pay attention to all details. Will definitely return.
reviews.author: Colleen

reviews.text: We have been staying at the Phoenician for several years. Primarily because it has a the only nice lodging near family and is part of the Marriott program. There are some bright spots at this resort but overall it is not worth the money we pay to stay here.
reviews.author: Makingmemories

reviews.text: It takes 15-20 minutes to get any department to answer the phone. Watch your folio upon checkout for unauthorized charges.
reviews.author: ProfessorK

reviews.text:
Review segment 1 of 4:

General: The food is excellent, but you'd be better off staying literally anywhere else and just visiting the restaurants. It's exorbitantly expensive, and they still charge you for something every time you turn around, and provide you the absolute bare minimum for a hotel stay (of any tier). The service would probably be great if they didn't overwork their employees and had more staff to take care of their guests. Oh, and don't think you can get in anywhere to eat or relax during your stay unless you've made reservations several days ahead of time. I have provided more detailed pros/cons below. You have been warned!

Negative:
-Room- My mother and I flew to AZ to aid in a family health issue, and because it was going to be a long and stressful visit, I thought I would treat my mother and myself to a stay at this luxurious resort (it was Mother's Day as well, after all). Because we would be spending all of our downtime during these 10 days at the resort, I wanted to make sure we had an absolutely spectacular view, as shown in the pictures on their website. Upon booking I emphasized this factor, and the concierge helped guide my room selection appropriately, although they recommended a follow up call before I flew out to verify the room selection. I called twice before arriving to verify, and each time was assured of the beautiful garden views we'd get to enjoy during our 10-day extended stay. I traveled for 16 hours to get there, and at the end of a long day, I arrived late in the evening for check in. Before even going to the room to get settled for the night, I again verified the room requirements with the concierge. He said he was unsure of the view of that room, but if we were unsatisfied with the space once we got there, he would happily move us. (This is laughable in retrospect). It took several minutes to get to our room, as it was the very last one at the end of the hotel, past many utility spaces and conference rooms.  It was probably a storage space that was later converted to a room. The room was spacious, but seemed unfinished (some items in the room were still extremely dirty (spilled makeup, and a few unknown substances), there was a garbage bag still in the room, and the beds looked as though they'd merely been made, not newly cleaned). I was so exhausted after traveling so long that I was willing to let these issues go so I could get to sleep. But then we opened the draperies to assess our "beautiful view" that we'd be gazing at for the next 10 days: it was the gravel rooftop, huge metal exhaust vents for the hotel, and their loading dock where utility vehicles and delivery men frequented! It was so ludacris it seemed to be a cruel joke. The bellhop asked about where to put our luggage, and I felt awful making him wait, but the concierge insisted we call if there were any issues with the view, and this was too much to overlook. However, after being on hold for almost 10 minutes, I finally got through to the concierge, only to find out that moving us to another room would be IMPOSSIBLE as they had every. single. room. booked out for the next several days. And this was not at limited capacity due to Covid restrictions, this was every single room being taken up on the entire property! About halfway through our stay they'd have a room open up elsewhere on the property, but until then we were stuck.  When we moved, we were glad to at least have a better view, but the second room was so cramped that you couldn't leave the room if either of the closets or the bathroom doors were open! Surely this is a fire hazard?! We also had an alarming cleanliness issue in the new room (the second day of our stay there we discovered someone had spilled popcorn in our room in the middle of the floor while we'd been out! There isn't even a microwave in the room, and this happened while we were gone during the day, so it was very alarming to find).
reviews.author: Danica Thomas

reviews.text: Our family of 4 had a great time. Totally relaxing. Pool service from Gennaro and Heather was amazing. Ate poolside for lunch every day. Huge portions. J&G was excellent too.  Room was spacious and clean. Can’t wait to go back!
reviews.author: SFtraveler

reviews.text: This hotel was not good. The food was horrible for the cost, it took 2 hours for the bell hop to bring up the bags after calling. There was broken glass in the hallway. The staff was rude at both of the restaurants.
reviews.author: Peter

reviews.text: Amazing resort, we will be back!
reviews.author: Puja

reviews.text: The High Tea Experience is wonderful!
reviews.author: Bevin Coddington

reviews.text: Our trip was incredible.  We really just like to relax and hang out.  The pools were so much fun.  The views are incredible and being located in Paradise Valley is where every foodie should stay.  You're literally within 10 minutes of every fine dining establishment.
reviews.author: Tim

reviews.text: Bad food. Bad drinks. Average upkeep (broken glass and food in several halls). Bell service was the highlight, everything else drops off.
reviews.author: NatefromKc

reviews.text: Gabrielle was supposed to be the guest experience did not provide great service at all
reviews.author: MByun

reviews.text: Great service! Love the hotel
reviews.author: IngaBond

reviews.text: Great resort
reviews.author: Steve Case

reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful and there is a lot to do.  Sierra, our Waitress at the Thirsty Camel Bar was an absolute delight and made the dining experience really enjoyable.
reviews.author: Steven Wallace

reviews.text: I enjoyed our recent visit the The Phoenician there were great vistas great drinks and overall a nice setting. The pool was maintained and the staff outside was exceptional. The check in process was slightly delayed and then rushed as there was only one other front desk person attending the new guests. The bar area is great with wonderful service and drinks well poured!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: The Phoenician is located in an ideal area, approximately 10-15 from the airport and Old Town. Camelback mountain as the backdrop to the resort is stunning! The golf course is beautiful and well maintained. The rooms were nice, however our room in particular was dirty and not well maintained. The steakhouse on the resort was great minus the steaks. They were legitimately the worst steaks I’ve ever had. The steaks were full of ligaments and gristle. After a long day of travel and playing 18 we just laughed about it and had a great night of sleep. Beds were comfy and pillows were great. We really enjoyed the compactness of the resort and would stay again.
reviews.author: JamieM

reviews.text: My stay was just okay...nothing to right home about. Not sure if it’s COVID or something else, but the hotel seemed very average...clean but average. A wind advisory posted for the umbrellas and pools would be helpful. Also, an explanation of the available amenities would be helpful upon check in.
reviews.author: J

reviews.text: My vacation at the Phoenician was wonderful. Not only was the resort all I anticipated, but being with my family after the Pandemic was relaxing yet exciting.
reviews.author: MariaT

reviews.text:
In the many resorts before. This one stood out to myself and my family. As soon as we checked in to the time we left we felt we were cared for and appreciated. The grounds the golf course I’m so beautifully manicured well taken care of which really impressed us. The pool and the staff around the pool was outstanding!
Each restaurant we visited was top notch and enjoyed each and everyone of them. Would recommend and will be back for sure!
reviews.author: Kyle

reviews.text: Outside of a few extremely minor service issues, it was a fantastic stay. We loved relaxing by the pool and taking advantage of the fitness facility and bikes made available through the resort fee.
reviews.author: NickS

reviews.text: Stayed at this resort for two nights and had a great time. The room was pretty good, but didn't spend much time in the room. Instead, spent most of the time at the pool, restaurants, and the golf course. Good vibe, friendly and helpful staff. I'll return.
reviews.author: SteveB

reviews.text: The pools were disgusting, we would be swimming with balls of hair touching our feet. Dirt along the entire bottom. Staff was not helpful- when asked if any chairs were available the response was “you’re more than welcome to look around yourself” never returning or recommending to anyone.
reviews.author: AlyD

reviews.text:
Stayed at phoenician with friends on a weekend golf getaway. The hotel was very busy and the staff was as attentive as possible under the circumstances. The concierge made great restaurant suggestions. 
 The rooms  (we had pool view deluxe king) were dated, dark, and carpet was stained.  Towels were rough and scratchy, beds were soft , and the pillows were like marshmallows. When will someone realize these rooms need recessed lighting and fabric softener for the towels? Bathroom amenities were generic and sparse.
reviews.author: Randi

reviews.text: Need more time in the sun at the resort!
reviews.author: BrendonS

reviews.text: Construction was never advertised at this "5 star resort" which is actually a 2.5 star hotel. We feel incredibly ripped off and had we known the resort was under major counter would have never stayed here. The rooms and hallways were very dirty with dust and mold and the waitstaff was too light and service was very poor.
reviews.author: Upsetfamily

reviews.text:
Person that checked me in was rude. If I could have gotten my money back, I’d have walked out and not stayed at all. 

No complaints about the room. 

Dinner at Mowry was bad. Service was slow (in fairness they were busy and still getting up to speed), but at least very friendly and made a genuine effort), but food was bad. Salad shouldn’t have been served (lettuce turning brown), inedible pasta dish. Menu itself was a challenge; every item seemed to include some unusual and not appealing item (e.g., pickled blueberries with your steak).
reviews.author: NotAgain

reviews.text: Very poor front desk help. No food or alcohol available after 11pm. Will actually downgrade your room. No late check out. Poor experience.
reviews.author: RMason

reviews.text: Quality destination for business or pleasure, superior service & attention to detail.
reviews.author: Marriott0017

reviews.text: Very nice Marriott property. Just not quite at the level of a JW or Ritz.
reviews.author: Tim Craig

reviews.text: It was amazing. The golf course in great shape,greens perfect and running 6-7 fast.
reviews.author: Kevin Criswell

reviews.text:
Considering this is rated a 5 star hotel the bathroom facilities in our room were sadly lacking, I could hardly turn around  in the shower! The shower head did not provide enough water for a decent shower and the toiletries were sadly lacking - the hair conditioner was like carnauba car wax! We were locked out of our room due to a malfunction in the door lock which required "mechanical" services to recharge the lock. (I don't need these hassles on a long awaited vacation!)
Ending on a positive note otherwise the hotel was entirely what a 5 star hotel should provide - excellent service, cleanliness and a very positive staff attitude .
reviews.author: Englishdame

reviews.text: The level of attention to detail at your resort is amazing! The food and service were outstanding. Thank you for a great experience.
reviews.author: Steve

reviews.text: We stayed at the Canyon Suites and it was a wonderful experience from the service we received to the attentive staff. Highly recommended!
reviews.author: Dennis Gregor

reviews.text: Carpet had dirty spots. I had to have housekeeping take care of it. Bar soap is not available without asking for it. The hotel room doors slam all the time. The doors need some type of pneumatic mechanism to stop the noise.
reviews.author: Aazz

reviews.text: Excellent opportunity to enjoy a girls trip the way I dreamed. Attention to detail was never missed. I can't wait to return.
reviews.author: Pouncy

reviews.text: We had a wonderful experience at the Phoenician and will definitely back.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Outstanding experience!!!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: This was probably the most upsetting places I have been. Usually everything at the Marriott Brands are exceptional. They are always very clean and if there is a problem it is fixed immediately. The cleanliness at the Luxury Resort was was appalling!
reviews.author: JBS1

reviews.text: Beautiful resort but extremely over priced for what you receive. This resort caters to high paying clientele and anyone outside of that doesn't seem to matter. Also, not enough servers at the pool. There are better resort in Scottsdale to stay at.
reviews.author: RachelK

reviews.text: Very nice weekend with my family!  My son loved the pool and the late checkout option was perfect for a few extra pool hours!
reviews.author: CRogers

reviews.text: Truly marvelous resort with extensive amenities, features, restaurants, and pools!
reviews.author: John Dugas

reviews.text:
I may have hyped myself up as I was so excited for a night away! We were really excited for a micro vacation since we have been COVID-19 safe for over a year. We booked for my birthday, my son's birthday, and mother's day. We even used a suit nights reward, which might have been the undoing... 

Our room was nice, but I wouldn't say it was luxury...  The stairs to the room were covered in purple flowers and leaves, which make them slightly slippery. Our room was located directly across from a smokers area, and everytime someone smoked the smell and smoke went right in to our room. We couldn't leave the door open or spend much time outside on the balcony since we were being smoked out of our room. 
There was an incident with the spa desk (I sent this to them directly) and maybe some additional training would be helpful for them. 
The beds were very comfortable, the bell services were quick and pleasant.
reviews.author: BeckyD

reviews.text: Spent Mother’s Day weekend at the hotel and spa.  Exceptional.  Treated like royalty. Spa attendant, Paula, made our experience welcoming and effortless.  Brandon, spa cabana server, made sure every request was promptly taken care of. Food and beverages were fantastic. Christopher, Thirsty Camel server, greeted us quickly and ensured our cocktails were amazing despite a super busy night. Our weekend was unforgettable.  This will become our Mother’s Day tradition.  You won’t want to miss this resort.
reviews.author: SB

reviews.text: I would not recommend a stay here. They brought me sheets covered in blood stains, and their service was sub par. Takes forever to get a drink or food, and nothing was above average.
reviews.author: KatherineLane

reviews.text: A room with a horrible view. Cobwebs in the window and a scorpion in the bathroom.
reviews.author: Paul

reviews.text: Our overall experience was not as expected. The hotel seems dated and the service was lacking. It took over an hour from the time we found someone to take our order at the pool till it was brought to us. Even the bar upstairs was extremely slow. The pool area  was dingy, definitely needs to be pressure washed.  I would not go back.
reviews.author: LPE

reviews.text: Nice property but a little dated.  Restaurants and bars are very good.  Recommend staying in the Canyon Suites vs the main hotel.
reviews.author: AlandTina

reviews.text: Spectacular views, a dessert botanical garden, superb steakhouse and services along with a terrific golf course. What else do you need?
reviews.author: JimL

reviews.text: Weed on a subterranean concrete wall view. Older accommodations.
reviews.author: PatDeon

reviews.text: The Phoenician was a breath of fresh air compared to 2 other resorts we stayed at during our 10 day AZ trip.  They cleaned our room everyday very promptly no lame excuses about COVID like the other places we stayed.  We had top notch service at the pools, which were clean and sparkling and great service from the pool staff, amazing drinks, and food.  The J&G steakhouse was wonderful and so was Mowry and Cotton.  We had drinks on the patio at The Thirsty Camel and the manager came out twice to check on our service.  Every staff member we came into contact with was friendly and so accommodating!  This place is very well managed, kudos to Joanna.  We stayed at another Bonvoy property which was supposed to be a level 6 and it was nowhere near the Phoenician in terms of service or cleanliness.  We will definitely return to this resort in the future.  My husband and I were dealing with a tremendous family tragedy and this stay really helped ease some of our pain.  Thank you to all of the wonderful staff!
reviews.author: LauraS

reviews.text: Best pkace we ever stayed at.
reviews.author: Gabe Levy

reviews.text: Still a great hotel.  But housekeeping lacking
reviews.author: JamieYoung

reviews.text: I’ve stayed at this property many times for business and vacation. We took our son here for the last night of his senior trip and the property did nothing disappoint. We played golf and he said it was the best course he had played. The food was amazing as well as the staff. Needless to say, we will be back many times!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Room was not ready when I got there even though it was 2 hours past the guaranteed time.  They charge your card for the whole stay plus 40% and they didn't tell me.  My card got shut down due to suspicious activity and I found out when it was rejected trying to pay for a meal with business associates.  I was humiliated.
reviews.author: Garyn

reviews.text:
+ Beautiful Resort
+ Pools are excellent
- Lack of vegetarian dining options
- Minimal activities for kids, outside of the pool
- Too pricey for what I got in return
reviews.author: PiyushArora

reviews.text: Great Place.  Will definitely be back.
reviews.author: Chad

reviews.text: We enjoyed the pools, fitness center and bikes, and golf. J & G Steakhouse was amazing although pricey. We had trouble the first night (Sunday) finding a place to eat at the resort as everything was booked. The rooms are spacious. Do not count on late check out even if you are a Gold Elite member as it was not given.
reviews.author: JAM

reviews.text: While the hotel had posted signs for safety, at no point were they enforced. Groups were roaming around without masks, red solo cups were a normal sight, groups were jamming themselves onto elevators etc. My wife and I felt unsafe and felt for the staff being exposed like this. Management did not appear to care about COVID protocols despite the signage posted throughout the hotel. I would not stay here unless you are fully vaccinated and even then I would give it a second thought.
reviews.author: RickGorka

reviews.text: Beautiful resort with staff who goes above and beyond to make your stay fun and relaxing!
reviews.author: SamanthaBrown

reviews.text: Nicest staff I recall in recent years, everyone was very warm and considerate and always spoke so politely.
reviews.author: CovidCoupleRetreat

reviews.text: There are so many options in this area, and I'm beyond disappointed in last stay.  I got a room for me, my wife and her best friend in town.  As a lifetime platinum, I was very surprised with a handicap accessible room with a closet not even big enough for them to hang their dresses.  If anything, I was surprised that I didn't even get the room I booked, but also that no upgrade was offered.   Then I was told I couldn't have late check out on Sunday.  Never in the last 15 years as a platinum has this happened to me.
reviews.author: JStiles

reviews.text: Staff was great! Beautiful property. Close to the airport and downtown Scottsdale!
reviews.author: Martina

reviews.text:
There are 5 Star places that work so hard to be called that, they lose sight of why a 5 Star place is 5 Star. Well, the Phoenician is NOT that place. They are truly 5 Star in every sense of the term.

Customer service is exceptional (and I travel the nation training top notch customer service so have a clue what I'm talking about here) facilities are top notch and the place is quite frankly beautiful.

I stayed here for a business trip but will be return with my wife for our Anniversary. Top top top notch.

PS, it may be a few dollars more than hotels in the area, however it is very much worth it.
reviews.author: Doug Lynch

reviews.text: Everything about the Phoenician is 5-star. It wanted to get away for my birthday and this experience was beyond my expectations. From the landscape, hotel staff, room cleanliness and amenities I was wowed. There is never enough time in a day to do everything but I will be certain to return. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: RLambirth

reviews.text: Extremely elegant and clean
reviews.author: JDub 84

reviews.text: While the property is beautiful and the room comfortable, the service was far below what one expects at a five star resort.  From the filthy refrigerator brought to my room, the failure to be served at all at the pool while I sat there for two hours, to the poor response from the front desk manager, and the non-response from the general manager, I have to say that this resort scores extremely poorly on service.
reviews.author: ReviewbyJoe

reviews.text: My wife and I had perhaps our best-ever travel experience recently, staying at the Phoenician. The grounds were immaculate, the staff was professional, the golf was great and the food was exceptional.
reviews.author: PeterK

reviews.text: Housekeeping was below average. The staff was excellent and well trained. Pre visit communication waS poor. Not the experience we has typically received at the property. Staff manager used being busy as excuse .
reviews.author: Kimculp

reviews.text: The Phoenician is the perfect weekend getaway! The grounds are beautiful, the hotel is nice and the we love the golf course.
reviews.author: ChristieE

reviews.text: Thirsty Camel great night relaxing
reviews.author: Ricky Harris

reviews.text: Great resort. Beautiful scenery! Great staff and service throughout is exceptional
reviews.author: Melissa Vesloski

reviews.text: The Phoenician was my first post-vaccination leisure trip. I greatly appreciated the room upgrade given to me on arrival. I also received some breakfast vouchers. However, the breakfast staff was visibly crestfallen every time I presented my voucher (and in one case never returned to my table).  Pool service was great and we loved the beautiful grounds. The day we left, the car service arranged by the hotel was at least 20 minutes late. Noone was at the front desk to help us find alternative travel arrangements or check in with the service. Finally, beware of the gratuity tacked onto every service. I was not informed that this was the policy and double tipped before I realized..
reviews.author: NJTravelor

reviews.text: Service at the Phoenician can’t be beat! Quick service at pool for towels and food/drink, friendly front desk personnel and concierge. Bottles of water available throughout resort. Good experience with the kids club staff (love how they have pivoted to Covid-safe activities during this time rather that cancelling all events)
reviews.author: Mary

reviews.text:
I have never had anything stolen from my room and the facility was probably better for a younger couple with kids not people if our age who want more relaxation

The masseuse I had at the spa was fantastic I don’t remember her name
reviews.author: GaryGilyardMD

reviews.text: Customer service, aesthetics, comfort.  A stay at the Phoenician is an amazing experience.
reviews.author: JoanelleLucas

reviews.text: Watch your bank account! I was charged double for my entire stay. I understand things happen, I asked to have the extra charge refunded no big deal. Well here we are 4 weeks later no funds credited back. I have to call every weekly (today is my 4th call back) and keep asking for them to credit the money and I have been promised by the manager Erick oh they are so so sorry and we will take care of it. Luxury resort but garbage customer service. There were some other negative things that happened while we were staying here but I'am just going to leave it at that.
reviews.author: Justin Tyler

reviews.text: We have traveled quite a bit in the past year And this by far has been our favorite stay. The staff was on top of things for sure.   This was a great place for our girls trip but will totally be bringing back the family next time.
reviews.author: MeganJ

reviews.text: We as a group felt very safe,enjoyed our meeting.Had a wonderful and memorable time.Thank you
reviews.author: natarajanravendhran

reviews.text: Enjoyed my stay. The best place for a vacation in Scottsdale!
reviews.author: PRASUN

reviews.text: Always a Wonderful Vacation-Event Experience at the Phoenician!
reviews.author: Deb

reviews.text: Really nice location.  Pretty upscale location.  Good service and great attention from the staff.
reviews.author: Mike Taylor

reviews.text: This establishment might as well not be part of the Marriott umbrella.  No accommodations for elite members.  Front staff was rude.
reviews.author: Ted

reviews.text: My husband and my honeymoon to Maui got cancelled last minute due to the lab losing his covid test, instead of doing nothing we did a staycation at The Phoenician for a couple of nights. I cannot say enough about this place! The concierge staff was incredible and gave us a beautiful view. They left us a bottle of champagne with chocolates for us in our room. The pools were beautiful, the servers at the pool were efficient and the drinks were excellent. The rooms are spacious and beautiful. We had dinner at the J&G steakhouse - highly recommend! We had drinks at the Thirsty Camel, and breakfast at Mowry & Cotton. I highly recommend The Phoenician! Thanks to everyone there for making our stay amazing!
reviews.author: LauraWarren

reviews.text: My husband and my honeymoon to Maui got cancelled last minute due to the lab losing his covid test, instead of doing nothing we did a staycation at The Phoenician for a couple of nights. We had drinks at the Thirsty Camel, and breakfast at Mowry & Cotton. I highly recommend The Phoenician! Thanks to everyone there for making our stay amazing!
reviews.author: Laura Warren

reviews.text: We loved the relaxed yet elegant feel of the resort. There was so much to do and see - and the location is perfect! With Camelback mountain as a backdrop, it couldn’t have been more breathtaking. The staff was always friendly and helpful. We will be back!
reviews.author: Sandy

reviews.text: Our recent visit at The Phoenician was our first time staying at the property.  The grounds are absolutely beautiful and the staff were very friendly and helpful!  There was never an issue getting chairs at the pool, and the pool staff was also very friendly and attentive.  The food was great in all of the restaurants, and the golf course was beautiful!  However I would be cautious about the type of room you book.  In the midst of all that beauty we ended up with a view of the roof and what seemed to be a lower level of basics in the room (i.e. worn towels and toilet paper from recycled paper) that you would not expect from a resort like this.  When we booked online there was no mention of a roof view.   If we were to come back we would call to ensure we do not get a room along the roofline.
reviews.author: GR

reviews.text: One of my favorite hotels!!! Just beautiful!
reviews.author: JulieLovley

reviews.text:
I stayed at the resort from 03/18/21 - 03/23/21. I originally booked my stay through Orbitz. Despite paying for my stay 100% in advance months before our stay, at checkout, I was charged for my stay (+ incidentals) at checkout. I've called Orbitz and they provided me evidence that they paid Marriot for our stay and there is nothing they can do to assist further. I've spoken to Marriot corporate and they have acknowledged the problem. Apparently I'm not the only guest to experience this problem.

Despite regular assurances my money would be refunded, it's been almost 30 days (aka. a full credit card billing cycle) and I have yet to receive my refund.

I'm still waiting for my $5,126.06 to be refunded with no relief in sight.

The resort is beautiful, but their customer service, and sorry, their room service food quality, is worse than that of a Red Roof Inn. I wouldn't recommend staying here. I've never scene anyone so nonchalant and OK stealing $5,000.00 from a customer before.

I guess... never trust these people with a debit card - LOL!
reviews.author: Bret Bonnet

reviews.text: Nice hotel and great location!
reviews.author: Guest

reviews.text: We selected the Phoenician as the location for our annual "Pacesetter" award trip for the top performers in our business.  We brought 3 employees and their spouses for a 4 to 6 night stay at the resort.  It's a very nice resort.  I am trying to keep in mind that this industry is in recovery from a horrible 2020, but it didn't live up to my very high expectations for the price tag.  We were lucky to hear before our trip that the restaurants fill up quickly, so I worked with the concierge to make dinner reservations in advance but other guests weren't as lucky.  The hard surfaces around the pool needed a GOOD hosing - my feet were absolutely filthy at the end of every day but the lounge chairs around the pool were nice and there were lots of big shade umbrellas.  Food and beverage prices were to be expected at a 5 star resort and the service was excellent across the board.  I appreciate the bottled water in our room and the coffee service but OMG, that toilet paper could give a person paper cuts.  Also, I have stayed at many luxury resorts (Florida, Hawaii, Mexico) and have never been told the one day rental fee for a pool cabana would be $300+.  That was disappointing and several of the cabanas were sitting empty so they might want to rethink that pricing.
reviews.author: ToniG

reviews.text:
Our porch had not been cleaned in I don't know when.
they did not vacuum during our stay.
They did not pickup a hanger or used cups or glasses.
Robes where not rehung.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: A great family vacation where we enjoyed golf and pool time.  The pool staff were great and we plan to come back again.
reviews.author: OmaHauber

reviews.text: Overall we had a very lovely stay
reviews.author: Jones

reviews.text: Beautiful Luxury at its finest
reviews.author: Cattrina Nanez

reviews.text: Absolutely loved this resort. From the location to the service, food and cleanliness. I will definitely be back
reviews.author: Zena

reviews.text: We spent five relaxing and thoroughly enjoyable days at the resort. I had stayed here once before for a conference. My wife’s first experience here was delightful. Service was outstanding at every occasion. Health club was clean and well appointed. Food was excellent from room service to the restaurants. Staff was friendly and helpful without being intrusive. We will return again next year for sure.
reviews.author: Sam

reviews.text: This hotel is truly one of the best I’ve ever stayed. The food is delicious; as good as high quality restaurant. The resort is very clean, and not just Covid clean. The pool areas were understandably crowded but there were never dirty dishes, glasses or used towels laying around. Never! The service was on par with a Four Seasons - attentive, efficient, and friendly. The gym and game room were well appointed with beautiful views and high quality machines and weights. We had a perfect 5 days and can’t wait to return!
reviews.author: BeachyKate

reviews.text:
We stayed 4 nights at the Phoenician Easter week.  Very busy.  COVID protocols were great and consistent.  The grounds are gorgeous and immaculate.  So are all the public areas.  Service and food was excellent as well.   The pools were very crowded but we always had 6' distancing.

If the price point is acceptable it is a fantastic restort.
reviews.author: HT165

reviews.text: Had afternoon tea and it was very delicious and tasty. What a cute experience. Can’t wait to come back and bring my daughter.
reviews.author: Eleni Pantelides

reviews.text: I've stayed at the Phoenician about 7 times over the last 10 years. This resort is a consistent performer! The service, property amenities (pools, gym, golf are awesome), and accommodations are fantastic! I'm Platinum with Marriott and travel quite a bit, in my opinion, this is the best hotel in Scottsdale (love the proximity to Old Town, the downside to the Four Season Troon).
reviews.author: JSV

reviews.text:
This is a beautiful property with excellent service. Our king/pool view room was nice and large. Seems like they skimped on furniture. Room was pretty bare and the furniture that was there wasn't comfy. The couch thing on the patio is ugly and ours was dirty.
Very, very nice service from all.

reviews.text: The resort is wonderful. Spent the week there for spring break with family. Top notch amenities and service with well groomed grounds. Lots to do with golf, tennis, basketball, spa, yoga, lounging  by pool and dining.

The room we had faced the main hotel entry and did not provide any view.  We thought the cost of the room was high for the location of the room.  The dining was top notch, and they made every effort to seat you even if you didn't have a reservation.

reviews.text: The number of guests far exceeded the hotel's ability to deliver the high end experience that I have experienced in the past at this hotel.

reviews.text: The Phoenician has the nicest rooms of anywhere in Scottsdale.

reviews.text: I have explained everything in detail earlier in this review

reviews.text:
First vacation in the time of Covid and found the experience to be very pleasing and safe.  The hotel staff did a good job in following safety protocols.  

The surrounding area for shopping/restaurants were very easy to access and getting back/forth to the hotel.  The central location helps with navigating to trails, eateries, shopping, and is only 15 min's from the airport.

reviews.text: This resort is absolutely stunning & so well kept! We had a great experience on our family vacation!

reviews.text: Charged me for items that were not mine, rude people, bad housekeeping, food was not good, overpriced!

reviews.text: Hotel looks great, service not so good.
reviews.author: Milan

reviews.text: Always a lovely experience. I ha been coming here for 30 years!
reviews.author: Debra Lentz

reviews.text: Grounds are beautiful, friendly staff, quiet large rooms. This is my family's second stay at Phoenician and won’t be our last. We rented a daybed the entire time and well very expensive worth having our own space and good pool service. Highly recommend reserving space at pool in advance as every day it was sold out and staff doesn’t come out until 10:30. Food was good and service was friendly. Workout room requires masks and ensures limited customers which created a line a few days. Rooms are large and quiet and clean. Couldn’t hear others. It was very hard to get transportation  and hotel couldn’t help. This appeared to be more related to the industry recovering faster than capacity as it was Spring Break.
reviews.author: ChicagoFamily

reviews.text: The resort and staff were all amazing. The servers that went above and beyond were Art, Hannah and Gretchen.
reviews.author: ChristinaC

reviews.text: Took my family (kids 6 and 9) and thoroughly enjoyed our experience.   They have a great kids club that puts on activities (mostly free) for kids throughout the day.   We used the free bikes and biked around the neighborhood adjacent to the property.   The cactus garden was a favorite and the other landscaping is beautiful.   Did their free yoga class daily.   Kids loved the pools, waterslide and splash pad,   We are coming back!   As a gold member, got upgraded to a fabulous corner room with a great view too.
reviews.author: ERGray

reviews.text: Grounds were stunning but food, service and cleanliness could be improved.
reviews.author: Lauren

reviews.text: Gorgeous resort. Top notch!  Excellent service and attention to detail.  Pool always crowded but staff helpful to find seats. Luxurious rooms with large bathroom and comfortable beds. Would definitely stay here again.
reviews.author: Amy B

reviews.text:
The resort itself is very nice. Clean and well maintained. We ate at the restaurants, had room service, had service poolside, went to the spa and golfed at the resort. The biggest issue for us was our Garden View Casita, which I had expected to be more detached from the other casitas on a nicer part of the property due to the drastic price increase from the basic rooms. Our casita felt like an apartment building, no elevator to the second floor which is fine for us but we didn't realize that the casitas would have two stories in the first place. Our "garden view" was the blank wall of the golf club with a shrub growing up half of the balcony with a main road used for traffic to the parking garages and for the maintenance crews on very very loud trucks. I thought that "Garden View" would be of the cactus garden that they are famous for at the base of Camelback Mountain or something along those lines. We asked if we could move rooms, even if it cost more or meant moving to a basic room in the main building but they said they had nothing available but they would credit us $50 per day of our stay, which we never received. The golf course was pretty nice, didn't realize it was partially on a construction site for the new homes being built. The golf cart was supposed to have bluetooth to connect your phone to for music so we didn't bring our little portable speaker but the bluetooth didn't ever connect.
The restaurants are very nice, we ate at the steakhouse one night and had their 5 course dinner which was amazing. We also had breakfast at Mowry and Cotton, my husband loved his Huevos Rancheros, my Eggs Benedict was probably the worst I have ever had, and I order it a lot. The 'ham" was actually a piece of turkey sandwich meat that had been pan fried and the bread was weird, not sure if it was homemade english muffin or maybe gluten free but it was stale and not very good. My latte was great.
The pools were very nice, we had drinks poolside and it was very relaxing, very crowded but still fun. Hot tubs still not open.
The spa was lovely, we had couples massages and had drinks by the pool. The jacuzzi is by reservation only and one person at a time. I was under the impression that the spa jacuzzi was co-ed and that my husband and I would be able to use it together but I was incorrect.
All in all, the facilities are nice but the if you get a bad room it could really mess with your "peace and tranquility" that your probably hoping for booking a resort like this.
reviews.author: KingFamily

reviews.text: We really enjoyed our time at the Phoenician and will definitely be back.
reviews.author: Mike

reviews.text: If you’re a titanium elite member and want to use points don’t bother with this place. We were shoved in the worst location nowhere near any amenities. The room was run down. See pics for our view. Nothing done nor offered. Simply, you aren’t getting an upgrade. We booked 8 weeks in advance. Absolutely not worth the money.
reviews.author: Jennifer Ransford

reviews.text:
Very friendly staff . Victor at the pool was wonderful . The staff at the spa were amazing ! Paula in the locker room so friendly . Front desk staff at the spa excellent ! Yoga on the lawn was fantastic . The instructors so good ! All of the restaurant servers were very friendly with outstanding service. 
Note: suite 3138 is not a pool view
reviews.author: KProom3138

reviews.text: Beautiful property.  Casita not worth the extra money.  Service was inconsistent.
reviews.author: LP

reviews.text:
The property is beautiful and well maintained, but service was not on par with a resort of this quality.  Staff was nice and courteous, but our trip began with the check-in agent writing the wrong room number on our key which we figured out after we unloaded all of our bags.  We had a room with a kitchenette.  It was stocked with small plates and forks, but no spoons and bowls, which we figured out when we were making a snack.  We were told this was due to COVID which I just don’t believe.  Somehow a spoon and bowl is more dangerous than a fork and plate?
At night we went to make up the pullout for our daughter and there were no sheets or bedding for it, which we figured out at bed time.  Every time we called the front desk we were on hold for no less than 5 minutes, this time was no exception.  We were told they were backed up and it could take 30 minutes to get the bedding to us.  45 minutes later we received a blanket and pillow...no sheet.  This would’ve all been in the room at a Hampton Inn.  I would expect the same here.
Our first morning we had breakfast at Mowry and Cotton.  We were given no tickets at check-in for our Bonvoy Continental and our waiter seemed unaware of how to credit us so we had to deal with that when we checked out.  Not a big deal, but again just seems to reflect a lack of training.
I really couldn’t believe the hold times at the front desk.  Perhaps they are understaffed due to COVID, but honestly I’m bothered by that being an excuse for everything these days.  Game room is closed but the pool, spa and gym are open.  Game room is too dangerous I guess?
I’ve stayed at many Marriott properties in the last year and simply received better more consistent service...even during the pandemic.  Our experience at the Keirland was superior.
reviews.author: SpencerMDT

reviews.text: We had a great family stay at the Phoenician!  Rooms were very cleaned and staff and service was great!!
reviews.author: Jaye

reviews.text: One of the nicest resorts we’ve ever stayed at. Food and drinks are amazing and service was great. The beds are incredibly luxurious and comfortable.
reviews.author: Benu Patel

reviews.text: Stay here if you don’t care about customer service and do not mind having your requests ignored or waiting 30-45 minutes to check in or receive your drinks and apps. And don’t bother complaining, the managers will pretend to hear you out and never apologize. Only the pool and golf staff nailed customer service - they are wonderful. This hotel’s only saving grace is some of its amenities.
reviews.author: VERYUNHAPPY

reviews.text: The setting is beautiful. We enjoyed two full days at a cabana by the pool (Rich, the attendant, is superb!) and another full day of tennis and spa activities.
reviews.author: MGfromVirginia

reviews.text: Mostly a great 5-star resort.  Long (> 10 minute) wait times to call the front desk.  Restaurant menu selections are limited (and odd), but quality of food is excellent at most restaurants.  Limited availability of seating, so make reservations for dinner before you arrive.
reviews.author: DrJ

reviews.text: The staff always went above and beyond and made our stay extremely enjoyable.  The price is high,  but it is a luxury resort.
reviews.author: ES

reviews.text: Overall, great stay and we will be back.  Service was excellent from top to bottom.  Pool staff was amazing and hotel was spotless. We also appreciated how serious the staff took covid, that was one of the reasons we came there, we were there in June and liked the professionalism and protocols around the pandemic and felt comfortable bringing back our whole family.
reviews.author: DKP

reviews.text: We truly enjoyed our stay.
reviews.author: JamesC

reviews.text: Expensive and not worth the money.
reviews.author: KCFamily

reviews.text: I arrived at 3:30 in the afternoon with a guaranteed room time at 4 pm. I did not get to my room until 5:30. Upon leaving I was double-billed for my room for 3 of the 4 days. When I contacted the billing department the man was arrogant and not helpful.  His remarks were condescending and said it is what it is. Not going back to the Phoenician as there are many nice Marriott properties around to put up with this.
reviews.author: DavidF

reviews.text: Promises made, promises broken. Dismissive staff.  "Resort view" means parking lot. Food is sub par but priced for perfection.  Housekeeping staff was really the only standout positive.  Find a different resort...Phoenix has plenty
reviews.author: DisappointedParent

reviews.text: Everyone was great, with the exception of a man at the front desk.  The rest of the staff seemed to be working hard to provide the best possible experience despite Covid restrictions.  The one area it is not enforced is in the fitness center.  Many were not wearing masks or just having the mask barely cover their mouth (nose out) and the staff didn't enforce it.
reviews.author: JN

reviews.text: Room was nicely kept up but felt based on how many nights I spend at Marriott properties that I was treated as a commodity versus a dedicated loyal member. Those working at Fitness facility need a lesson on customer service.

reviews.text: By the title, you can tell this is my favorite hotel in one of my favorite cities.  The service, cleanliness, location and amenities are truly 5 star.

reviews.text: Just gorgeous!!
reviews.author: Michele Moore-Jankowski

reviews.text: Great tennis facilities - although must book in advance. Only 7 courts and most taken with juniors lessons. Would like to see regular clinics offered that guests don’t need to book in advance. Would also like to see the tennis clubhouse open later and food/drink offered there - at least for delivery. Nice older property which has been remodeled. Lots of walking required to get around. Bell desk and lobby bar staff are overwhelmed. Seems like plenty of staff - but not really efficient.
reviews.author: Andrew

reviews.text:
My wife and I were very pleased. The exterior design and architecture is a little dated. However the interior renovation updated it nicely to today’s expectations. 
They were attuned to CV 19 protocol but we did not feel stifled from enjoying our stay. 
Great job folks!!!
reviews.author: Nothanks

reviews.text: The service at the hotel was disappointing and did not align with the price of the hotel room. I’ve received better service from 3 star hotels.

reviews.text:
Not good. Housekeeping so bad we felt uncomfortable staying in the room
We are not usually complainers
We we’re constantly calling for things such as coffee they would forget to leave 
The phone system is not adequate I would be on hold endlessly many times

reviews.text: Stated before, service was poor and staff was not ready for a bust week
reviews.author: Scott

reviews.text: Beautiful resort, terrible service!
reviews.author: AB

reviews.text: We tend to use this property for quick visits to the metro area for business purposes as we grow our firm’s activities in the area. Returning this September for a business retreat.
reviews.author: GreggfromHBS

reviews.text: We have stayed here a number of times, and are always surprised that they can maintain such high standards. During Covid-it was even better!
reviews.author: Happycouple

reviews.text: The golf course was nice, and the food options at the resort were good. Feel like the rooms are definitely overpriced for what you get though. Will stay somewhere else next time where you get more bang for your buck.
reviews.author: Daniel

reviews.text: I absolutely loved staying here, it was so relaxing and beautiful, everyone was very helpful and nice. I will be back very very soon!
reviews.author: MaliaB

reviews.text: My wife and I have had the privilege of staying at The Phoenician twice for the ASU + GSV EdInnovation Summit. This resort is absolutely beautiful, cradled at the base of Camelback Mountain. With cacti gardens, desert scenery, beautiful pools, and a range of fantastic on-site dining, I would love to come back for a few days just to relax. As a conference venue, it was also extremely well-suited. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Nate Smith

reviews.text: Good
reviews.author: Mary Rose Browder

reviews.text: If I'm honest, the Phoenician was not quite as good as I expected it would be.  The overall resort was fantastic, but I expected a bit nicer room.  I've stayed at plenty of JW, Ritz and other high end Marriott properties and to me, this one was touted as one of the finest, but the room felt aged and not anywhere near as luxurious as I thought it would be.
reviews.author: RS

reviews.text:
We stayed there for 4 days/3 nights. We enjoyed the pools, restaurants, and the gardens. The service was a mixed bag, most were excellent but some clearly lacked training, towel person almost bumped us with his massive cart while going through the door to the pool instead of allowing us passage, the lady at the breakfast restaurant greeted us every morning by “how many” instead of good morning or a pleasant welcome. The servers inside the restaurant however were all excellent and pleasant. 
The room was the biggest let down, we had to change rooms twice, 3 different rooms, first 2 rooms essentially looking at a wall or a slab of cement, the 3 rd room has acceptable view but clearly was not maintained well, had to change air filter which was black and clearly way overdue when we complained about loud airflow noise, the safe needed maintenance too to work properly. By the pool the slide was not working 1st day but was fixed the next, unfortunately when my wife and kids used it, their swim suits had blue stain on the back and were ruined. The access to the trail head was closed so we didn’t get to go on a hike.
reviews.author: Sam

reviews.text: We come to Scottsdale every March for Spring Training. The last couple of years we've stayed at the Phoenician which has been a great experience. The staff and amenities are great!
reviews.author: HollyF

reviews.text: My family and I love to visit, great staff and great facilities
reviews.author: Bruce Genthe

reviews.text: TOTALLY DELIGHTED WITH EVERY ASPECT OF OUR VISIT!  WILL TELL ALL OUR FRIENDS AND LOOK FORWARD TO STAY AGAIN.  IT WAS PERFECT!

reviews.text: Beautiful place and the staff is amazing!
reviews.author: Courtney Skoraczewski

reviews.text:
There is no place like the Phoenician! 
The hotel is stunning, rooms all updated and gorgeous, pools exquisite and all of this with exceptional service.

For the amount of $ spent, the staff felt a little disproportionate in terms of customer service. I had exceptional CS, and I had lackadaisical CS as well. I wish for a more standard and consistent level of execution and care.

reviews.text: We waited over 20 minutes for a drink in the Thirsty Camel; we waited over 30 minutes for a 2nd drink poolside while having lunch and service poolside typically was a 20-30 minute wait for all items.  Beautiful property, kind employees, but not the service one would expect for such a high end property.
